**Job Title:** Senior Quality Engineer

**Location:** UK Wide (Remote/Hybrid)

**Role Type:** Permanent

**Clearance:** Active SC (Security Cleared) or SC eligible

**Who we are**

We're the largest pure play Quality Engineering consultancy in the UK.

Over the past 6 years, we've redefined what quality and testing look like at 2i and to our clients. Born from a desire to view quality holistically across the entire SDLC, our Quality Engineers (QE's) are at the heart of delivering world-class consultancy services.

Proudly certified as a "Great Place to Work", 2i are the chosen employer of around 300 QE's and we're continuing our growth.

**What we're looking for...**

We're looking for people who let curiosity lead them. We don't expect to have a team of "experts". What we do expect, is for #Team2i to be...

* Inquisitive
* Open to challenge and be challenged
* Taking initiative
* Accountable

You have experience with various types of software and infrastructure and are passionate about helping to improve the quality of products you work on, through questions, curiosity and exploration. Our projects and clients are diverse, so what we really look for are people driven to develop and expand their skillset and knowledge.

**About the Role:**

We're looking for an experienced **Senior Quality Engineer** to join one of our collaborative engineering teams, working on a large-scale, business-critical platform within a fast-paced Agile environment.

This is an opportunity to work within a highly collaborative, automation-focused team structured into smaller delivery pods, where you'll contribute to the quality of complex applications and services. You'll work closely with developers, business analysts and stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle, designing and executing automated tests while helping to ensure high-quality software delivery.

You'll be joining a supportive and experienced team that values collaboration, continuous learning and knowledge sharing. As a Senior Quality Engineer, you'll have the opportunity to mentor others, influence quality practices and contribute to continuous improvements across both your immediate team and the wider engineering community.

**You'll need to be...**

* Highly experienced in Automation, with deep commercial experience developing automated test frameworks using **Java** and **Selenium**.
* Experienced with **BDD** frameworks such as **Cucumber/Gherkin**.
* Solid experience working with **REST APIs** using tools such as **REST Assured** and **Postman**.
* Commercially experienced integrating automated testing into **CI/CD** pipelines using **Jenkins**.
* Familiar with containerised and cloud-based environments, including technologies such as **Docker**, **Kubernetes** and **AWS**.
* Experienced working with **Git** and version control as part of collaborative software development.
* Confident designing effective test cases, debugging automation failures and carrying out root cause analysis.
* Comfortable working with **SQL** databases and data validation, with exposure to relational and NoSQL databases being advantageous.
* Experienced working with performance, security and non-functional testing tools such as **Gatling** and **OWASP ZAP.**
* An exceptional communicator when it comes to stakeholder management and the ability to build effective working relationships across cross-functional teams.
* Experienced working within Agile and Waterfall delivery environments, with a solid understanding of the full software development lifecycle.
* Interested in coaching and mentoring others, supporting junior quality engineers and helping drive engineering best practice.
* Adaptable, proactive and able to balance changing priorities while maintaining high-quality standards.

**What we can offer you...**

* Leadership pathways tailored to your personal and professional development, providing clear direction for your career at 2i.
* 26 days annual leave, plus the option to buy or sell up to five additional days.
* Private Healthcare alongside a range of wellbeing benefits including gym memberships, counselling services and Cycle to Work schemes.
* Annual performance bonus of up to 10%, linked to both individual and company performance.
* Flexible hybrid working across the UK.
* The opportunity to work alongside highly skilled Quality Engineers on modern technologies while continuing to develop your technical and leadership capabilities.



We don't believe in the "perfect" hire. What we do believe in is building diverse teams with different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. If you're passionate about Quality Engineering, eager to learn and excited by solving complex technical challenges, we'd encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement.

Reappointment for the Delivery Phase will be subject to the Museum securing the full grant from the Heritage Fund and required match funding,  as well as satisfactory performance in the Development Phase.

Set in the small village of Brook, in the heart of the beautiful Kent Downs National Landscape, the Museum occupies a magnificent Grade I barn and Grade II oast house containing a collection of farming and rural implements, offering visitors vivid insights into rural life in the horse-drawn age.

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join The Almonry Museum for The National Lottery Heritage Fund ‘Re-Imagining the Almonry’ Development Phase as the **Curator**.

## Clinical Seating Engineer

**Active Design** **Role: Clinical Seating Engineer  
 Benefits: Free on-site parking, Legal and General pension contributions, 27 days annual leave with increase to 29 and 33 days with continuous service, paid sick leave with continuous service, Employee Assistant programme**

Active Design is leading manufacturer of wheelchair special seating products and clinical seating services. The company has been involved in the design, development and manufacturer of postural management equipment for over 30 years. Our products are manufactured at our factory in Aston, Birmingham using a wide range of production techniques.

**What we are looking for:**

We are seeking to recruit an enthusiastic Clinical Seating Engineer that will prescribe seating systems which are shaped individually to service users, most of whom will have complex needs, based on clinical data gathered at assessment and the response of the person to the supporting surface.  They will work in conjunction with the wheelchair service clinicians to develop optimised support for the individual.  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manipulating the material directly to the service user
* Capturing a shape using vacuum consolidation bead bags
* Manufacturing a bespoke tubular framework to support the cellular structure and interfacing this to wheelchair bases
* Adapting/modifying equipment to meet specific needs
* Creating bespoke solutions where off-the-shelf equipment cannot be obtained to meet the person’s needs
* Handing over the completed system to the service user
* Making further adjustments to the system over time to allow for growth or changing need.

The role requires integration of clinical and technical knowledge with practical application, taking account of the service user’s functional needs, which often conflict with their postural requirements, and the fact that people can present differently on different days and that factors beyond their control have an influence on their ability to tolerate/respond to a seating system.

Whilst responsibility for the individual’s episode of care lies with the local clinician, the post holder is responsible for ensuring that the needs of the individual are met in an effective and safe manner.  As an autonomous practitioner you will:

1. Be managed, rather than supervised; results/outcomes are assessed at agreed intervals through clinical supervision; this will be guided by precedent and policy
2. Provide high quality, service user focused assessment and prescription of wheelchair seating, also including manual wheelchairs, powered wheelchairs and buggies
3. Work within professional and regulatory standards, and clinical/technical guidelines, promoting best practice and undertaking all aspects of clinical and technical duties
4. Provide specialist clinical and technical advice to other members of the team and contribute to the development of clinical and technical services
5. Possess expertise within the specialism of wheelchair services, underpinned by developed clinical and technical theoretical knowledge and experience
6. Regularly perform development work in relation to service user specific clinical/technical requirements
7. Plan and deliver training sessions for health and social care professionals

The job holder will work in a variety of settings including clinics, community centres, and service users’ homes according to service requirements.  In addition, they will participate in clinical governance activity, including CPD and developing and implementing quality improvements within the service.

We are looking for someone to work 40 hours per week Monday to Thursday between 8am to 5pm with a half hour unpaid lunch break and 2 x 15-minute breaks (paid) and Fridays 7am – 1pm. This role can be home based but with the understanding that requirement to attend clinics around the South and South East region and be out in the community plays a big part of the role and therefore you must also hold a valid UK driving license with no more then 6 points on.

Allica Cashflow Finance provides tailored lending solutions to established, profitable businesses whose funding needs are supported primarily by sustainable cash generation rather than tangible collateral.

Our growing team combines detailed financial analysis, commercial judgement and relationship-led delivery to structure funding solutions that meet each client's needs while maintaining a clear understanding of risk.

From the first meeting, we develop a deep understanding of each business, its strategy, financial performance, cash generation and funding requirements. That analysis informs credit assessment, facility structuring and risk management, and provides the foundation for the ongoing client relationship.

**Role Description**

The Cashflow Finance Analyst will be a core member of the deal team, working alongside Regional Leads on new-to-bank lending opportunities from the initial client or adviser meeting through credit approval, documentation and completion. The Analyst will take an active role in understanding each business, its funding requirement and the key drivers of financial performance.

Financial analysis sits at the heart of the role. The Analyst will evaluate historic and current trading performance, assess cash generation and debt service capacity, challenge forecasts, build sensitivities, and identify key risks and mitigants. They will translate this into clear, well-reasoned recommendations that support credit decisions and the structuring of appropriate lending facilities.

The Analyst will help drive transactions through the full lending process, coordinating with clients, advisers, Credit, Legal and other internal stakeholders to resolve issues and maintain momentum. * Assess earnings quality, cash generation, leverage, liquidity, working-capital requirements, debt service capacity and covenant headroom, identifying trends, risks and mitigants.
* Build, review and challenge financial forecasts and transaction models, including base-case and downside sensitivities, to evaluate affordability and resilience throughout the proposed facility term.
* Prepare clear, well-supported financial analysis and credit submissions, working with Regional Leads to formulate recommendations and respond effectively to questions from Credit and other decision-makers.

* Help manage each transaction through credit approval, documentation, satisfaction of conditions precedent and completion, taking ownership of actions and maintaining momentum against agreed timelines.
* Act as a key point of coordination between prospective clients, advisers, Credit, Legal, panel firms and other internal stakeholders, communicating clearly and resolving issues promptly.
* Maintain accurate and current deal, pipeline and activity records in Allica's CRM system.

* Strong financial analysis capability, with the ability to interpret complex financial statements, management information and forecasts and translate them into clear commercial and credit conclusions.
* Proficiency in financial modelling and sensitivity analysis, including assessment of cashflow, leverage, liquidity, debt service capacity and covenant headroom.

## **About AlphaSense:**

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

**About The Team**

The Customer Success team is composed of 3 teams: the pre-sales team, the post-sales team, and the support team. This role would manage the UK Financial Services Pre-sales team - a critical driver of growth. Pre-Sales Consultants act as trusted partners to our Account Executives, working closely with prospective clients to demonstrate the value of our platform and help win new business. They are problem-solvers, storytellers, and product experts who thrive on helping customers make better and faster decisions.

Pre-Sales Consultant combine deep product knowledge, commercial acumen, industry experience and strong client intuition to run high-impact evaluations. They work across Financial Services verticals, engaging with decision-makers and users to uncover use cases, run tailored demos, and guide prospects to successful outcomes. Additionally, because of the extensive exposure they have with clients, they are also in a prime position to partner with our Product Management and Content teams to help determine future product developments that will resonate with the market, as well as playing a key role in product Betas and the customer feedback loop.

**About The Role & What You’ll Do:**

The Pre-Sales Manager (FS team) will be responsible for managing a team of Pre-Sales Consultants who are responsible for :

* Partnering with Account Executives to run seamless product evaluations and drive new business across key verticals
* Lead product demos, discovery calls, and tailored workshops to uncover and position value
* Translate client challenges into compelling use cases that showcase the power of AlphaSense
* Collaborate with Support, Sales, Product, and Content teams to close feedback loops and influence roadmap priorities
* Maintain a consultative, user-first mindset throughout every evaluation, building trust and credibility with prospective clients and cross-functional stakeholders

We are looking for a team oriented, data-driven leader who can have an impact on the continued growth of this team. The duties of the Pre-Sales Manager include:

* Directly leading a team of Pre-sales Consultants who are responsible for supporting AEs in closing trials by providing white glove and value-add client service.
* Aggregating feedback and pivoting pilot programs to allow for optimal renewal rates, revenue growth, and uncovering the key support this team can offer to our revenue organisation. As part of this, taking initiatives is key to continuously improving our organisation & updating internal processes.
* Coaching and mentoring members of your team on development, call coaching, implementing best practices, and establishing accountability across the team. As part of this you will drive onboarding, certification and ongoing enablement programmes in partnership with Sales Enablement. This includes adapting your managerial style to each direct report to effectively support and challenge them.
* Providing transparency and insight into your team’s performance to management, which includes tracking and reporting day-to-day metrics.
* Evaluating & implementing resource coverage models to support growth, and recruiting top talent for your growing team while maintaining a high bar of excellence.
* Building impactful relationships with cross-functional leaders (Sales, Account Management, Sales Enablement, Product, Marketing, etc.) to ensure alignment and drive successful growth outcomes.

Company Description
We're ASOS. We blend our flair for fashion with our love of cutting- edge technology, but more importantly were interested in how we can bring the best out of you.
We exist to give people the confidence to be whoever they want to be, and that goes for our people too. At ASOS, you're free to be your true self without judgment, and channel your creativity into a platform used by millions.
Job Description
Our approach to working together means that ASOSers are required to be in the office at least three days per week. This enables stronger collaboration, faster decision‑making, and a strong team culture, while still offering the flexibility to work remotely when appropriate.
Digital Product at ASOS
At ASOS, we’re proud to be a global fashion destination serving over 23 million active customers across more than 100 markets, with 2.5 billion visits annually. Our Tech team is at the heart of everything we do, powering the digital experiences that make ASOS a leader in online fashion retail.
We operate as a product‑led organisation, where empowered, cross‑functional teams solve real customer problems through experimentation, data, and clear ownership. From identity and checkout to personalisation and fulfilment, we build platforms that scale globally and support long‑term growth.
The Details
We’re looking for a Product Manager to join Digital Product on a 12‑month fixed‑term contract, covering maternity leave. This role will lead our Customer Profile & Identity area - one of the most critical foundations of the ASOS digital experience.
Customer Profile & Identity underpins how customers register, log in, authenticate, manage their account, and experience personalised journeys across ASOS. The work directly impacts conversion, retention, security, data quality, and regulatory compliance.
You’ll be the product lead for a dedicated, cross‑functional squad, working closely with engineering, design, data, security, marketing and customer care. You’ll set clear direction, prioritise high‑impact opportunities, and balance customer experience, commercial outcomes, and risk.
This is a hands‑on role for someone who enjoys autonomy, can move from strategy to delivery, and is comfortable operating in a technically complex space.
What you’ll be doing
Own the product vision and roadmap for Customer Profile & Identity, covering registration, login, authentication, account management and customer data foundations.
Drive measurable improvements in conversion, login success, retention and customer experience, using clear success metrics and experimentation.
Lead initiatives to reduce friction in registration and authentication, while maintaining strong security, privacy and compliance (GDPR, customer consent, data protection).
Partner closely with engineering, design, data, security and analytics to ship high‑quality, scalable solutions.
Balance short‑term commercial wins with longer‑term platform and data health.
Use customer research, behavioural data and experimentation to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses and inform prioritisation.
Communicate clearly and confidently with senior stakeholders, building trust through strong narratives and evidence‑based decision‑making.
Stay close to industry and competitor trends in identity, authentication, personalisation and account‑based experiences, translating insight into action.
Qualifications
About You
Proven experience as a Product Manager working on customer‑facing, high‑traffic digital products, ideally within e‑commerce or consumer platforms.
Experience owning foundational or platform products (e.g. identity, profile, account, payments, checkout, personalisation, data platforms).
Strong understanding of customer journeys across registration, login and account management, and how friction impacts conversion and retention.
Comfortable working in agile, cross‑functional teams alongside engineers, designers and analysts.
Data‑driven mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g. Power BI, Adobe Analytics, Contentsquare, Optimizely or similar) to inform decisions and measure impact.
Able to navigate technical complexity, security considerations and regulatory constraints without losing sight of the customer.
Clear communicator and storyteller who can bring stakeholders along the journey and make trade‑offs explicit.
Proactive, pragmatic, and comfortable taking ownership in a fast‑moving environment.

Employee discount (hello ASOS discount!)
Employee sample sales 
25 days paid annual leave + an extra celebration day for a special moment 
Discretionary bonus scheme 
Private medical care scheme 
Flexible benefits allowance - which you can choose to take as extra cash, or use towards other benefits 
Opportunity for personalised learning and in-the-moment experiences that enable you to thrive and excel in your role

Are you ready to harness in vitro display platforms to unlock the next generation of peptide therapeutics for patients? Based at our Discovery Centre in Cambridge (UK), you will join a multidisciplinary team operating at the interface of technology and biology. You will design and execute robust experiments, analyse complex data with modern tools, and translate insights into high-quality candidates and platform improvements. Can you see yourself building smarter libraries, running decisive selections, and using data and automation to make better decisions faster?

**Accountabilities:**

* Peptide Discovery Campaigns: Lead end-to-end selection campaigns using mRNA, phage, yeast, and ribosome display, delivering validated peptide hits with clear go/no-go criteria.
* Library Design and Engineering: Design and generate high-quality peptide and scaffold libraries that maximize diversity and fitness for purpose, aligned to target biology and downstream developability needs.
* Selection Strategy Innovation: Devise and execute enrichment strategies that improve specificity, affinity, and functional outcomes; iterate based on data to increase hit quality and rate.
* Next-Generation Sequencing Analytics: Apply NGS to quantify enrichment, decode sequence-function trends, and guide prioritization and optimization.
* AI- and Data-Driven Decisions: Use AI, machine learning, and computational methods for sequence prioritisation, library design, and lead optimisation to improve success rates and speed.
* Automation and Workflow Development: Implement and refine automated workflows to boost throughput, reproducibility, and efficiency across discovery activities.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with protein sciences, assay development, and therapeutic area teams to align discovery outputs with biological function and clinical relevance.
* Rigorous Experimentation and Documentation: Plan, execute, troubleshoot, and optimize experiments; maintain accurate, high-quality records and communicate results clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Platform Advancement: Propose and implement new selection strategies, chemistries, and workflows that expand capability and impact of peptide discovery across the portfolio.
* Delivery and Impact: Translate scientific creativity into tangible pipeline assets and platform innovations that increase probability of technical success and shorten time to patient benefit.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**

Education & Experience Requirements:

* PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry, protein engineering, peptide science, or a related discipline, with relevant postdoctoral or industry experience; alternatively, a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with substantial equivalent experience in peptide or biologics discovery.

Required Skills:

* Strong hands-on experience in molecular biology methods and technologies (e.g., PCR, RT-PCR, cloning (ligation-dependent and independent methods), site-directed mutagenesis, Sanger sequencing/analysis), ideally applied to generation of peptide (or other protein scaffold) libraries.
* Extensive experience of peptide hit identification and engineering using display technologies such as mRNA, phage, yeast, and ribosome display, including library design/generation, and selection campaigns using diverse enrichment strategies.
* Experience with next-generation sequencing (NGS) applied to peptide discovery.
* Experience applying AI, machine learning, and/or computational methods to therapeutic discovery, ideally in support of peptide hit finding, sequence prioritisation, library design, or lead optimisation.
* Experience with automation and/or workflow development to improve discovery efficiency, reproducibility, and throughput.
* Ability to optimize protocols, troubleshoot, interpret experimental results/data and maintain accurate, high quality and up-to-date experimental records.
* Demonstrated scientific creativity, with the ability to propose and implement new workflows, selection strategies, and platform improvements that enhance peptide discovery and engineering capabilities.
* Strong communication skills in a team environment and an ability to learn and embrace new technologies quickly.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**

* Experience with incorporation of non-canonical amino acids in in vitro display systems and their application to peptide discovery or optimisation.
* Experience in therapeutic antibody discovery: hit identification and optimisation.
* Experience in high-throughput antibody screening, reformatting and characterisation methods including in vitro biochemical assays (ELISA, SPR, BLI or flow cytometry) and functional assays.
* Experience with leading/co-leading and/or managing research projects.

BNY is seeking a high-calibre Director, Business Risk to join the First Line of Defence team within Global Payments & Trade in London.

The successful candidate will help strengthen the business risk framework across Global Payments & Trade by enhancing risk transparency, governance effectiveness, and first line execution.

It offers the opportunity to influence how risk is managed across a strategically important platform at the heart of BNY’s client franchise.

The role

The Director will support delivery of the Global Payments & Trade risk strategy by bringing rigor, clarity, and discipline to the first line risk environment. The role spans executive reporting, governance, escalation oversight, and process and control enhancement, ensuring that business leadership has clear visibility of risk, strong management information, and effective support in addressing issues and priorities.

Working closely with senior stakeholders across product, operations, technology, compliance, legal, audit, and controls, the role will help translate strategic risk priorities into practical execution and stronger business accountability.

Key responsibilities

* Partner with the Global Payments & Trade Head of 1LOD Risk and Controls Management and senior leaders to support execution of the platform’s risk strategy.
* Lead the development of executive reporting, dashboards, and governance materials that provide clear insight into business risks, key issues, and strategic priorities.
* Drive effective first line governance across leadership forums, risk reviews, and control committees, with a focus on transparency, ownership, and follow-through.
* Oversee issue and escalation management, coordinating cross-functional responses and delivering clear, decision-oriented updates to senior stakeholders.
* Identify emerging risks, recurring themes, and opportunities to strengthen the control environment, governance model, and management information framework.
* Support process and control enhancement across payments and trade workflows, including remediation oversight, evidence management, and audit or regulatory readiness.
* Build strong partnerships across the first, second, and third lines of defense to reinforce consistency, accountability, and a strong culture of risk ownership.
* Contribute to team leadership through mentoring, high standards, and active support of a strong-performing environment.

Candidate profile

This role will suit candidates with a strong track record in business risk, controls, governance, or related disciplines within leading financial institutions.

The successful candidate is likely to bring:

* Strong domain knowledge in payments, transaction banking, cash management, trade finance, or a related wholesale banking environment.
* Proven experience and strong understanding of risk governance, operational risk, issue management, control frameworks, and audit/regulatory engagement within a complex, global, and regulated organization
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex operating and risk information into clear, executive-level reporting and actionable insight.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability, with the credibility to engage effectively across senior business and control stakeholders.
* Strong analytical capability, including experience with Excel, Power BI, or Tableau; familiarity with SQL, Alteryx, or Python would be advantageous.

Why this role

This is an opportunity to join a globally significant business in a role with real visibility, breadth, and influence. The successful candidate will work closely with senior leadership, contribute to the execution of a platform-wide risk agenda, and help shape how risk is governed across an important and evolving franchise.

For individuals seeking a role that combines strategic exposure, cross-functional influence, and meaningful impact, this represents a compelling opportunity.

Personal style

The ideal candidate will be strategic, credible, and execution-focused. They will be comfortable navigating complexity, challenging constructively, and bringing clarity to ambiguous issues. They will combine intellectual curiosity with strong delivery discipline and a clear commitment to strengthening risk management in support of business progress.

## Are you an experienced CRM Marketing professional looking to use your skills to benefit people and the planet? Join our team to shape a more sustainable future. Ready to make a difference?

***About CDP***

CDP is a global non-profit that runs the world’s only independent environmental disclosure system. As the founder of environmental reporting, we believe in transparency and the power of data to drive change.

Partnering with leaders in enterprise, capital, policy and science, we surface the information needed to enable Earth-positive decisions. We helped more than 24,800 companies and almost 1,000 cities, states and regions disclose their environmental impacts in 2024. Financial institutions with more than a quarter of the world’s institutional assets use CDP data to help inform investment and lending decisions.

Our team is truly global, united by our shared desire to build a world where people, planet and profit are balanced. Visit cdp.net or follow us @CDP to find out more.

***About the Team***

The Marketing & Communications function’s purpose is to Protect & Enhance CDP’s Brand, Connecting People to the Purpose through Storytelling, to Drive Sustainable Growth.

The Marketing team is responsible for building and stewarding CDP’s brand, developing and delivering campaigns that generate leads and drive audience action to meet organizational objectives, and maintaining high-performance engagement across digital channels.

***About this Role***

The Senior CRM Marketing Officer is responsible for planning, creating and sending emails to our diverse audience base, driving critical action and engagement.

***What you will do:***

· Build, implement and evaluate email marketing activity in response to internal briefs and campaign requirements using relevant systems, including D365.

· Ensure that email copy is accurate, on-brand, effective and salient for its audience, through a combination of writing from scratch, providing support and guidance to other teams, proofreading and copy-editing. Ensure adherence with tone of voice and brand guidelines.

· Work with teams internally to ensure information in emails is accurate, up to date and received by the most salient audience.

· Work with other teams to ensure the relevant stakeholders are aware of external comms.

· Build and maintain subject matter expertise on D365 Marketing and CDP’s use of it. Train others to use D365 to set up and send emails.

· Develop understanding of CDP’s audiences, their requirements and what resonates with them.

· Develop understanding of CDP’s CRM data architecture.

· Maintain awareness of email calendar and other external comms.

· Create and use complex segments and customer journeys in D365 based on best practice and requirements.

· Work with colleagues across Marketing to identify, implement and evaluate opportunities to run A/B tests.

· Evaluate the performance of email marketing activity, recommend and implement improvements.

· Work with the team to suggest improvements to processes and approaches.

Actively contribute to an effective and engaged team, clear on its purpose and contribution, by:

* Ensuring you know what is expected of you, through regular 1:1’s, having clear objectives in place, and participating in open and honest performance and development conversations
* Ensuring a respectful and inclusive workplace, where team members communicate openly, share knowledge so it can be used, and respect difference.
* Living the CDP Values and demonstrating the behaviours appropriate to your position.

Internal stakeholders include colleagues across Marketing & Communications, particularly the Campaigns Managers.

* Experience of delivering complex B2B email marketing campaigns within a global organization that communicates in multiple languages.
* Experience of using CRM systems independently.
* Ability to problem solve and troubleshoot issues within CRM
* Excellent data analysis skills.
* Strong written communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills, with the ability to build strong internal relationships and communicate findings clearly.
* Ability to work as part of a busy team with multiple stakeholders and adapt to changing requirements
* Excellent attention to detail.

**Salary and benefits**: The salary banding for this role is £32,157 - £40,197/year, 30 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, generous non-contributory pension provision, Employee Assistance Programme, life assurance, training and development, flexible working opportunities and other benefits.

* Provide operational and people management for a small rodent animal unit.

The Role
The Citation Group is building out its data and AI capabilities to be best in class. As part of this, we're looking for a Data Migration Engineer to join the data team and support in moving data safely and accurately between systems as we consolidate and modernise our platform landscape.
This isn't a generic ETL role. You'll be working on live migrations between operational systems (CRM, billing, and platform migrations) where the real risk isn't moving the data — it's the things that only surface once it lands: automation overwriting values post-import, subscription or contract logic that doesn't map cleanly, validation rules that silently reject or reshape records. You'll work closely with the Head of Data Migrations, data owners, and platform specialists (Salesforce, Chargebee, Dynamics) to make sure those gaps are found and designed for before cutover, not discovered during UAT.
We're looking for someone who's naturally curious about how systems actually work under the hood — not satisfied with a field-to-field mapping sheet until they understand the logic, constraints, and automation behind both ends of the migration.
Responsibilities
Lead structured data discovery and profiling at the start of every migration — surfacing quality, completeness, and integrity issues while there's still time to remediate them, and quantifying the remediation effort involved
Build detailed source-to-target data mappings grounded in a genuine working understanding of both systems — not just field lists, but the underlying logic, constraints, and assumptions each platform makes
Identify where source and target behave differently (validation rules, required fields, relationship structures, calculated vs. stored values, automation-driven overwrites) during discovery, and design for it rather than letting it surface as a defect in testing
Build and maintain the ETL/ELT pipelines that move data between systems, including transformation logic for edge cases (e.g. multiple active records per customer, hardcoded vs. derived fields)
Own reconciliation and validation between source and target post-migration, including tracing discrepancies back to root cause (data issue vs. platform automation vs. mapping error)
Document migration logic, mapping decisions, and known system quirks so they're reusable across future migrations
Work with data owners to drive cleanup of quality issues ahead of cutover
Support cutover planning and execution, including rollback considerations
The Person
We're looking for someone who can roll their sleeves up and dig into both the data and the systems around it. In addition, the successful candidate should have:
Excellent writing and communication skills with strong attention to detail — you'll need to explain system-behaviour gaps clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience writing, troubleshooting, and debugging advanced SQL queries
A track record of going beyond field-level mapping to understand why two systems behave differently — validation logic, automation, calculated fields, relationship structures
Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly diagnosing whether an issue is a data problem, a mapping problem, or a platform automation problem
Experience with ETL/ELT tools and data migration projects specifically (not just general pipeline building)
Programming experience in Python
Comfort working with ambiguity — migration requirements shift as discovery uncovers new system behaviour, and you'll need to adapt scope calmly rather than treat it as scope creep
Skills and experience we'd love you to have... but if not? We'll help you get there:
Experience migrating data into or out of CRM/billing platforms such as Salesforce
Understanding of how declarative platform automation silently alter data post-import
Experience in relational cloud-based database technologies like Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift
Understanding of cloud computing security concepts
Familiarity with DBT and Databricks
Experience working in an agile environment
Experience working with AI tools (Claude Code, Cortex, etc.) to accelerate migration analysis

The team is a specialist product and service group within HMRC’s Chief Digital Product Office (CDPO), responsible for supporting a diverse portfolio of tax regimes that underpin key areas of UK revenue collection. EEITTs/Specialist Tax covers a broad set of services and systems that enable HMRC to administer and collect taxes such as excise duties, environmental levies, insurance premium taxes, transport-related, and specialist taxes. These services are often complex, highly regulated, and operationally critical, supporting both customer compliance and HMRC’s assurance activities.

The team brings together product, service, delivery, and business analysis capabilities to manage the end-to-end lifecycle of these services, ensuring they are stable, secure, and aligned to policy and legislative requirements, while also driving modernisation and improvement. A key focus of the EEITTs/Specialist Tax team is transforming legacy tax services onto strategic platforms (such as ETMP), reducing operational risk, improving data integrity, and enabling more efficient and scalable tax administration across multiple regimes.

HMRC is made up of Customer Groups which are working independently towards one common goal. Our role sits within HMRC’s Chief Digital & Information Office (CDIO) Group that deliver in-house solutions for a broad range of technical and operational issues. Our digital delivery centres are hi-tech, state-of-the-art facilities that allow our teams to maximise their capabilities.

## Job description

A Product Manager is responsible for ensuring that a product is of high quality and delivers value. They manage their products through various phases of the product lifecycle, from discovery, development and build, to live running. They balance the goals of the organisation with the needs of end users, and the skills of the product team to scope and build the right products and prioritise how to iterate them over time. Additionally, they may be involved in recruiting and managing personnel within the product team, ensuring they hire the right individuals that are supported, and developed.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Set the product vision, strategy and scope: Define how the product will work to support the organisation or service’s goals and set the scope for what the product will initially do as an MVP, to how it will continually improve or the organisation and end user needs change for a large product or service.
* Stakeholder management: Engage with stakeholders to understand their goals from the service and product, secure their buy-in for the product vision and roadmap, and maintain good working relationships, including managing negotiations over the scope and timelines for product development.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary product teams: Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, which could include user researchers, service designers, business analysis, and software engineers, to shape and build the product.
* User Insight Integration: Work with performance analysts and user researchers to gather customer insights on products for iteration and improvement.
* Develop and maintain the roadmap prioritise the order in which high level features and functionality is built and released, based on what is most valuable to build first, and communicate this through road mapping.  Get buy in for the roadmap from key stakeholders and maintain the roadmap, prioritising and adding enhancements to the product over time to continually improve the product.
* Develop and maintain the backlog: Identify the team tasks (“user stories”) to build the functionality on the roadmap and create a backlog of user stories. Implement the relevant processes such as sprint planning or Kanban, so the team is regularly working through the backlog to build and release features and maintain the backlog to a high-quality standard.
* Build and maintain products to a high-quality standard: Collaborate with colleagues such as designers, user researchers, BAs or engineers to create products that are highly reliable, usable, and accessible for users with accessibility needs, in line with the government service standards.

* Community Engagement: Actively participate in the product management community of practice through initiatives, sessions, talks, or activities that help other product managers.
* Support and develop other product managers: this can be through line management, coaching or mentoring more junior product managers or supporting peers.

# Screening and Escalations Senior Payment Analyst

ClearBank Group Holdings

OverviewApplication

**Trust unlocks our greatest potential.**

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

**What you can expect:**

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our 1st line Financial Crime Operations team as a **Screening and Escalations Senior Payment Analyst?** Reporting into the Senior Manager, FCO Screening & Escalations you will be responsible for the oversight and investigation system-generated payment screening alerts. You’ll act as a subject matter expert for payment screening across our client base. You’ll also have an excellent understanding of financial crime typologies and detection methods and share this knowledge with Analysts within the team.

This role is critical in ensuring our compliance with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and protecting the integrity of our financial systems. You’ll be raising concerns and providing ideas, engaging with clients, and making informed decisions with your sound knowledge of payment services; excellent technical and regulatory knowledge across financial crime and sanctions within the UK and EEA, including reporting requirements, and you’ll have a firm understanding of how to identify and mitigate risks within a business.

**Your role includes:**

* Analysing and investigating system-generated alerts related to payment screening. You will use existing information or request information from clients and 3rd parties to support discounting of the alert.
* Analysing transactions to identify suspicious activities and potential money laundering risks
* Assessing internal and external intelligence to identify financial crime risk and escalate as appropriate. Where relevant you will raise internal Suspicious Activity Reports (iSARs)
* Ensuring all investigations and processes comply with relevant AML laws and regulations
* Acting as a first point of escalation for Payment Screening Analysts
* Managing escalations and senior management conversations in both first and second lines of defence
* Allocating tasks, assisting in oversight and prioritisation to ensure any deadlines are met
* Staying up to date on the latest AML trends, emerging typologies and best practices to enhance the effectiveness of our screening systems
* Maintaining detailed records of investigations and ensuring timely resolution of cases
* Following ClearBank procedures & standards, raising and escalating relevant reports where required to ensure compliance with relevant AML laws and regulation

**What you’ll bring:**

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

* Solid and demonstrated experience in AML, financial crime investigations, or a related field
* Strong knowledge across all forms of sanctions typologies e.g. Trade Sanctions, dual use goods, Personal and Professional enablers, payments involving complex structures
* Good knowledge of sectors such as money remittance, electronic money, and cryptocurrency firms would be beneficial
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all tasks
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate and negotiate with key/senior stakeholders
* Familiarity with screening and monitoring software/tools, and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong knowledge of money laundering typologies and experience in dealing with sanctions, complex business models, PEPs, red flags and suspicious activity investigation, bribery and corruption cases involving restricted jurisdictions
* In-depth knowledge of AML regulations and guidelines
* Strong ethical standards and integrity in handling sensitive information
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
* A recognised AML / Sanctions / Fraud qualification is desirable but not essential

Regretfully we are not able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes at the current time.

**What makes a great ClearBank team member? Does this sound like you?**

* You focus on solutions and positive outcomes, thinking radically and responsibly to find the best result for our customers, your colleagues and the bank;

* You actively seek feedback from others to drive your growth and development, always assuming positive intent from others and develop strong, trusting relationships you’re your colleagues and customers: you really, genuinely care;

* You always strive for the highest quality, but you know that done is better than perfect; you welcome a challenge knowing that they learn as you go and iterate;

* ‘I’ before ’we’, isn’t in your vocabulary

If this sounds like you then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

**What we offer in return:**

* We're flexible – We support a culture of flexibility which allows our employees to achieve a strong work-life balance.
* Offices – Work in a way that works for you – whether that’s in the London office, at home, or hybrid.
* Holiday – 27 days of annual leave per year, plus bank holidays.
* Holiday buy/sell - Buy or sell up to five days of annual leave each year and shape your year around what matters most.
* Work abroad – You have the flexibility to work outside of the UK for up to 30 days in a rolling 12-month period.
* Socials – Regular social events open to all.
* Holiday swap – Option to swap your bank holidays to any other day of your choice.
* Wellbeing – 24/7 employee assistance programme including mental health support, life assurance and income protection.
* Bigger than ClearBank – Take a couple of days per year to do something that matters to you.
* Healthy living – Private healthcare and discounted dental cover, with employee perks and discounts.
* Family – Enhanced family-friendly leave.
* Personal development – We offer personal development budgets, opportunities to take part in role-related training and unlimited LinkedIn Learning.

And not forgetting the biggest benefit of all. The opportunity to be part of an incredible team that’s building a tech-bank fit for the future.

**A little bit more about us!**

**ClearBank is Where You Can belong:**

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. * 42% of our senior management roles are held by women
* Our enhanced family leave policies
* Launching our partnership with Code First Girls

# Head of Financial Care

**We are Creditspring, a new way of borrowing that focuses on its members and provides them with safe and efficient short-term financial products.**

We're a fast-growing FCA-regulated consumer credit company. We have members, not customers and we take a lot of pride in that!

As one of the UK’s only subscription finance company in the market, we truly have a unique value proposition. Our mission is very clear; to improve the financial stability and resilience of our members. We do this through the products we provide, the partnerships we have, and our educational content. We want our members, and everyone in the UK to be able to better manage their finances and steer them away from high-cost, unregulated credit options.

**About the role**

Head of Financial Care is a newly created, senior leadership role at Creditspring, established to develop and own our end-to-end approach to collections and to supporting members experiencing financial difficulty. As we grow, we're investing in a dedicated function that gives every member who falls behind, enters a forbearance arrangement or debt solution, or shows signs of vulnerability a consistent, expert, and genuinely supportive experience.

**Responsibilities**

* **Regulatory Compliance and Consumer Duty Outcomes**   
  Ensure all collections and recoveries activity meets FCA requirements (CONC, Consumer Duty) and internal policy. Own evidence of fair treatment, good customer outcomes, and monitoring of Consumer Duty outcome metrics across the collections journey.
* **Vulnerable Customer Identification and Support**   
  Embed processes to identify customers in financial difficulty or showing characteristics of vulnerability, and ensure appropriate forbearance, signposting to debt advice, and tailored treatment paths are applied consistently.

* **Collections and Arrears Strategy**   
  Own the end-to-end collections strategy and process across early, late, and default-stage arrears, balancing customer outcomes, recoveries performance, and cost-to-collect, and adjusting strategy as the book and macro conditions evolve.

* **Forbearance, Repayment Plans and Affordability**   
  Set the framework for forbearance options (payment plans, freezes, reduced payments, write-offs) underpinned by robust affordability and sustainability assessments, ensuring plans are appropriate and not designed to disguise underlying arrears.

* **Third-Party and Outsourcer Oversight**Govern relationships with external debt collection agencies, litigation partners, and debt sale counterparties, including due diligence, contractual SLAs, conduct risk oversight, and ongoing performance and compliance monitoring.

* **Team Leadership, Capability and Quality Assurance**   
  Lead, coach, and develop the financial care teams, ensuring agents are trained on conduct risk, vulnerability, and regulatory requirements, supported by a robust call/contact quality assurance and monitoring framework.

* **Credit Risk, Provisioning and Impairment Collaboration**   
  Work closely with Risk and Finance on arrears trends, roll rates, cure rates, and recoveries performance to help inform business on IFRS 9 impairment provisioning, credit risk appetite, and decisioning.

* **Data, Systems and MI Reporting**   
  Ensure accurate and timely management information on arrears volumes, collections performance, forbearance take-up, and complaint trends, and drive effective use of tools, case management, and workflow systems.

* **Governance, Risk Reporting and Regulatory Liaison**   
  Provide assurance and reporting to senior management and the Credit Committee on collections performance and conduct risk, and act as a key point of contact for regulatory engagement, audits, and any reviews relating to collections.

* **Cross-Functional Partnership at Creditspring**   
  Partner with Product on the design of journeys for struggling and vulnerable members, providing the subject matter expertise in this area.

* **Compliance**  
  Work closely with Risk and Compliance on policy, controls, and regulatory change and act as the escalation point for complex or sensitive cases.

**What you'll need to succeed**

* Significant experience leading collections, recoveries, or financial hardship/vulnerable customer functions in consumer credit (minimum 5 years in a leadership role).
* Exceptional working knowledge of UK consumer credit regulation relevant to collections and vulnerability, including FCA Consumer Duty and CONC.

* Experience owning forbearance and/or debt solutions (IVA/DMP) processes.

* Confident operating at pace in a fast-moving, growing business with proven ability in successfully building, running and developing collections infrastructure.

* Experience overseeing outsourced debt collection partners, litigation partners, or debt sale processes, including contractual and conduct risk oversight.

* Exceptional experience managing both UK and offshore customer contact teams.

* Data-literate and hands-on with collections MI and dashboards, able to translate arrears and recoveries data into clear strategic decisions.

* A genuinely customer-centred approach to supporting members in difficulty, balanced with commercial and regulatory discipline.

* Current awareness and ability to stay up to speed with market direction on financial care in the consumer lending space, both in terms of technology and risk.

We’re committed to Creditspring being an inclusive environment where employees feel welcomed, valued and listened to; we want you to thrive as your true self.

### COMPANY OVERVIEW

---

Croud is a global, full service digital marketing agency with a unique business model that helps businesses drive sustainable growth in the new world of marketing. Croud was recently named a Sunday Times Best Place to Work for the second year in a row, and was named Performance Marketing Employer of the Year by PMW.

### ROLE OVERVIEW

---

We are looking for an experienced Technical Search Director to lead the strategic direction, operational excellence, and technical delivery of Croud’s Web Experience and Technical SEO capability, ensuring client websites are optimised for modern search discovery, AI chat engines, and technical performance across the Organic Performance portfolio.

As Technical Search Director, you will serve as Croud’s senior technical authority on Web Experience and Technical SEO workstreams. This is a specialist director role that combines expert-level, hands-on technical execution with cross-departmental leadership and agency-wide capability development.

Reporting into the Head of Organic Strategy, you will work in close alignment with Croud’s Organic Strategy teams to audit, architect, and roadmap technical SEO improvements designed for next-generation search. You will ensure client websites are fully crawlable, accessible, and structured for maximum content extraction, not only for traditional search engines, but also for AI summaries and conversational LLM interfaces. Acting as the vital bridge between SEO strategy and technical delivery, you will partner directly with client web development teams to translate audits into clear, actionable code specifications and tickets, while serving as the senior point of expertise on technical projects such as site migrations and platform rebuilds.

### RESPONSIBILITIES

---

#### **1. Technical SEO & New-Age Search Strategy**

* **Advanced Web Auditing:** Lead end-to-end technical site audits, identifying structural obstacles, rendering issues, and optimisation opportunities to enhance site usability, speed, and indexing efficiency. With experience with Apache configuration files (redirects) and knowledge of CLI (command-line interface) tools.
* **Next-Gen Search Optimisation:** Architect technical strategies tailored for modern search ecosystems, ensuring client websites are optimised for crawlability, accessibility, and content extraction across traditional search, AI summaries, and generative AI chat experiences.
* Semantic & Structural Design: Oversee structured data schema implementation, semantic HTML, site architecture, and rendering optimisation (client-side, server-side, dynamic rendering) to maximise machine understanding.
* **Performance & Core Web Vitals:** Oversee front-end web performance analysis, leveraging tools like Chrome DevTools, Lighthouse, PageSpeed Insights, and WebPageTest to drive Core Web Vitals compliance.

#### **2. Developer Engagement & Execution**

* **Actionable Ticketing:** Translate complex technical audit findings into clear, digestible, developer-ready specifications and tickets (e.g. Jira, Azure DevOps) that client engineering teams can seamlessly implement.
* **Developer Advocacy:** Work directly with client web developers, frontend engineers, and technical architects to communicate requirements, align on standards (W3C, WCAG), and validate implemented fixes.
* **Front-End & Code Expertise:** Apply strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to debug complex front-end SEO issues, client-side frameworks, and DOM manipulation challenges.

#### **3. Technical Project Leadership**

* **Site Migrations:** Serve as the senior lead on technically heavy projects, including site migrations, platform rebuilds, re-architectures, and international rollouts, protecting baseline traffic and mitigating operational risk.
* **Technical Roadmapping:** Formulate and manage robust technical roadmaps for key accounts, scoping accurate effort requirements and resource allocation.
* **Escalation & Technical Resolution:** Serve as the senior point of escalation for complex technical issues, indexing emergencies, or performance drops across the Organic client portfolio.

#### **4. Proposition Operationalisation & Innovation**

* **Evolving the Proposition:** Continuously modernise Croud’s Web Experience methodology with improved processes and agentic workflows to integrate emerging web technologies, generative AI search behaviours, and evolving search engine guidelines, whilst driving efficiency in delivery.
* **Test & Learn:** Lead regular "Test & Learn" technical initiatives to evaluate new tools, web standards, and indexing patterns, turning insights into client strategies.
* **Case Studies & Thought Leadership:** Produce high-quality case studies and whitepapers that showcase Croud’s technical SEO innovation and elevate the agency’s profile in the market.

#### **5. Growth & Capability Development**

* **New Business & Growth:** Support sales and pitch initiatives by delivering high-impact technical audits, pitch inputs, and solution design on complex technical opportunities.
* **Croudie Network Management:** Oversee brief quality, project management, and quality control for work assigned to specialist on-demand network experts.
* **Upskilling & Mentorship:** Provide ongoing training, mentorship, and technical guidance to Web Experience Managers and the wider Organic Performance team.

### PERSON SPECIFICATION

---

* Extensive experience in Technical SEO within an agency environment.
* Expert knowledge of Technical SEO best practice, site migrations and web performance optimisation.
* Strong understanding of AI search, emerging search technologies and the evolving search landscape.
* Confident working with developers and translating technical recommendations into actionable solutions.
* Commercially minded with excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proven experience leading technical teams and driving capability development across a business.

### COMPANY BENEFITS

---

Croud operates a **hybrid working model** with a **minimum of 3 days a week** based in our **London office** and the remaining days from home if you wish.

Croud offers a clear path to progression for all members of staff. We are committed to offering development opportunities alongside a support system of regular performance reviews. The opportunities are endless!

On completion of the three-month probation period, every employee is eligible for the benefits listed on our careers site which include:

* Sabbatical: Paid sabbatical at 7 years with an option to take it unpaid at 5 years
* 25 days holiday a year
* Discretionary annual performance based incentive
* Sale commission
* Recruitment referrals bonus
* Health & Wellbeing contribution
* 2 Recharge Days each holiday year
* Ride to Work scheme
* Railcard
* Season Ticket loan
* Home office screen
* Daily office perks: Free fruit, breakfast cereals, snacks, and tea & coffee
* Weekly treat: Enjoy a complimentary lunch on us every week
* Enhanced Primary and Secondary family leave as well as extended Parental Leave and Shared Family Leave
* Life insurance and income protection
* Medical Cash Plan
* Pension
* Curated 3rd party learning platform as well as access to Croud Campus (our bespoke learning and development platform)

Crown Agents Bank is a vastly growing and regulated UK bank that connects emerging and frontier markets to the rest of the world, using FX and payments technology. We are transforming the way payments and FX move through emerging markets, reducing friction so that more money gets to those who need it. Emerging markets payments are usually challenging, expensive, unreliable and opaque. Our solutions help fix these pain points. Ultimately, we connect traditionally hard-to-reach regions to global financial infrastructure, giving access to the best prices and the fastest, most reliable settlement.

FX and cross-border payments are often complex and expensive, especially when operating in emerging markets. Crown Agents Bank (CAB) wraps its deep and trusted relationships and strength of network around innovative digital capabilities, and cross-border transaction banking solutions to enable fintech, corporates, governments, development organisations and banks to move money to, from, and across often hard-to-reach markets.

## Job Description

**Role Purpose**

**Project Compass is one of the Bank's most strategically important transformation programmes, and this role will lead how change is understood, embraced and embedded across the organisation.**

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Transformation, the Change Management Lead will define and deliver the programme's change strategy, shaping its narrative, building stakeholder support, and ensuring the business is ready to adopt new ways of working.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring someone who can operate comfortably at both strategic and delivery levels. One day, they may be advising senior leaders on stakeholder strategy or programme positioning; the next, they may be creating communications, facilitating workshops, analysing stakeholder feedback, or building change artefacts themselves. We are looking for someone who enjoys rolling up their sleeves, brings energy and momentum to those around them, and is comfortable building approaches from first principles in a fast-moving environment.

The successful candidate will be a strong advocate for modern, AI-enabled ways of working, using technology to improve insight, accelerate delivery, and enhance the quality and reach of communications and change activity. As a key member of the Transformation Office, they will play a central role in helping Compass land successfully across the Bank.

1. Programme Narrative

* Develop and own the overarching Compass narrative, ensuring a clear, consistent and compelling story
* Define and establish the programme “brand” (tone, identity, messaging framework)
* Create core communication artefacts (e.g. slide decks, updates, FAQs, leadership briefings)
* Use AI tools to accelerate content creation, iterate messaging, and tailor communications to different audiences
* Act as a quality gate for programme communications to maintain consistency and clarity

2. Stakeholder Management & Engagement

* Develop and maintain a comprehensive stakeholder map across all impacted areas
* Build and manage a structured stakeholder engagement plan aligned to programme phases
* Leverage AI and analytics to enhance stakeholder insight (e.g. sentiment tracking, segmentation, engagement patterns)
* Identify key influencers, sponsors and potential points of resistance
* Support senior stakeholders with messaging, briefing materials and engagement strategies
* Continuously assess stakeholder sentiment and adapt approach in real time

3. Change Strategy & Planning

* Define and implement a pragmatic, scalable change management approach for Project Compass
* Embed AI-enabled approaches into change delivery (e.g. automated comms planning, impact assessment support, knowledge management)
* Establish core change deliverables (impact assessments, change plans, comms plans)
* Integrate change activity into overall programme plans and governance
* Ensure change considerations are proactively embedded into workstream delivery

4. Business Readiness & Adoption (as programme matures)

* Assess business readiness for change across impacted teams and functions
* Define and track readiness criteria and adoption metrics
* Use data and AI-enabled insights to identify adoption risks and target interventions
* Develop and deliver plans to support adoption of new processes, tools and behaviours
* Coordinate with SMEs and workstreams to ensure changes are understood and embedded

At Currys we’re united by one passion: to help everyone enjoy amazing technology. As the UK’s best-known retailer of tech, we’re proud of the service our customers receive – and it’s all down to our team of 25,000 caring and committed colleagues. Working as one team, we learn and grow together, celebrating the big and small moments that make every day amazing.

As the Service Design and Transition Lead at Currys, you will be responsible for overseeing the design, transition, and operational readiness of IT services. Your role will involve governing the project lifecycle to ensure a successful handover from project delivery into Operations. You will foster collaboration across departments and advocate for continuous improvement and strategic alignment in service design, with a focus on areas such as cloud and automation.

You will play a key role in building towards AI-enabled IT Operations — identifying pragmatic opportunities to apply AI and automation, helping shape Currys’ approach as it matures, and championing a culture of intelligent, cost-effective service improvement. This is an opportunity to genuinely influence how AI is adopted within IT at Currys, at a point where that direction is still being defined.

Your main duties and responsibilities will include developing and implementing a Service Design and Transition Plan, managing relationships with stakeholders, overseeing operational and financial aspects, providing training and documentation, driving continuous process enhancements, fostering cross-functional collaboration, coordinating Early Life Support, and making key decisions on service design and transition strategies.

## **Role overview:**

**Service Design and Transition Planning:** Develop and implement a Service Design and Transition Plan aligned with strategic objectives and Project Delivery Plans, ensuring service readiness and effective transition.   
**Service Design:** Craft and confirm effective support models that precisely delineate and manage a multi-partner and platform technology ecosystem. Incorporate AI-augmented service patterns such as intelligent triage, self-service automation and virtual agent capabilities.  
**Observability:** Ensure that solutions comply with observability standards, facilitating prompt and proactive/predictive reactions. Where tooling permits, leverage AI-driven monitoring and anomaly detection to enhance predictive capabilities and reduce mean time to detect and resolve.  
**Operational and Financial Oversight:** Oversee the integration of Non-Functional Requirements, manage the transition of Run Costs to budget holders, and ensure operational sustainability beyond project lifecycles.   
**Service Assurance and Continuous Improvement:** Advocate the Service Assurance framework, and represent service readiness in the Service Assurance Board. Proactively identify opportunities where AI tooling could automate repetitive processes or surface insights from service data.  
**AI Championing and Innovation:** Act as a visible champion for the pragmatic and responsible use of AI within IT Operations and Support. Collaborate with IT leadership to develop an AI adoption roadmap that is commercially grounded and contributing to a capability that Currys is actively building, rather than inheriting.  
**Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Foster a collaborative culture, drive early engagement and integrate Service Management principles into solution architectures for operational excellence. Proactively engage engineering, data and product teams to ensure AI considerations are surfaced during solution design and that service models are ready to support AI-driven patterns.  
**Early Life Support and Service Acceptance:** Coordinate Early Life Support, ensuring critical go-live support, and manage the agreement and communication of Service Acceptance Criteria.  
**Decision-Making and Escalation:** Make key decisions on service design and transition strategies, accountable for addressing misalignments with the Service Assurance framework.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

**IT Service Management Expertise:** Strong background in IT Service Management, including comprehensive knowledge of various service management processes and operational modalities.  
**Agile and DevOps Proficiency:** Demonstrated experience in leading service design and transition within Agile frameworks and integrating services into a DevOps operating model, highlighting adaptability and innovation.   
**Project and Portfolio Management:** Ability to oversee a diverse project portfolio, understanding different project delivery methodologies (Agile and Waterfall) and to act as an enabler for the smooth delivery and transition of Services into Live Service.   
**Technical Acumen:** Well-versed in key technologies, particularly cloud services and DevOps practices, along with proficiency in essential tools like ServiceNow, SharePoint, Excel, and Jira. Growing awareness of AI and automation tooling — including AIOps, ITSM-integrated AI and conversational platforms.  
**Problem-Solving and Adaptability:** Innovative problem-solver with a pragmatic approach, capable of navigating complex challenges and influencing outcomes. Applies an AI-aware lens when approaching service challenges — exploring where intelligent automation or data-driven tooling could deliver a more scalable or cost-effective solution.

## **Why join us:**

Join our team and we'll be with you every step of the way, helping you develop the career you want with new opportunities, on-going training and skills for life.

Not only can you shape your own future, but you can help take charge of ours too. As the biggest recycler and repairer of tech in the UK, we’re in a position to make a real impact on people and the planet.

Every voice has a space at our table and we're committed to making inclusion and diversity part of everything we do, including how we strengthen our workforce. **About DataCamp**

Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors.

In this role, you'll collaborate with instructors and teams across curriculum, engineering, product, and marketing to build and scale the assessments and certifications that prove those skills—helping millions worldwide validate what they've learned and signal it to employers.

**About the role**

This is an individual contributor role. You will own the design and production of DataCamp's assessment and certification content, working with subject-matter experts and building AI systems that generate, review, and continuously refresh high-quality, defensible questions at scale. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle for assessment and certification content—from blueprint and item design through review, publication, and ongoing maintenance—and manage deadlines across it.
* Design psychometrically sound assessments: write and review items, define scoring and passing standards, and safeguard validity, reliability, and fairness.
* Build and operate AI workflows—prompting, pipelines, and evaluation—that draft, grade, and quality-check items, so content production scales without sacrificing rigor.
* Source and collaborate with subject-matter experts to keep certifications current with the fast-moving data and AI landscape.
* Map certifications to the real skills hiring managers screen for, so a DataCamp credential is a credible signal to employers.
* Benchmark against the wider certification landscape—competing programs, industry standards, and emerging role definitions—and set the strategy for where our certifications go next.
* Continuously assess certification performance using pass rates, item statistics, and learner and employer feedback to drive improvements.

**Qualifications:**

* A technical background in a STEM field—such as Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Statistics, or Engineering—paired with experience evaluating technical competency (e.g., designing coding assessments, technical interviews, certification exams, or graded coursework), so you can judge whether an assessment item is accurate and genuinely tests skill.
* Demonstrated expertise in assessment design—item writing, scoring, standard-setting, and the validity, reliability, and fairness principles behind credible certification—with proven experience building or running technical assessments or certification programs.
* A clear grasp of the skills hiring managers actually screen for in data and AI roles, and how to translate them into what a certification measures.
* Strong experience with agentic AI systems such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Replit, and building AI automation systems. You can demonstrate you've increased your output 10x with AI.
* Graduate degree (Master's or PhD) in a related STEM discipline, or equivalent industry experience with hands-on expertise in data science, machine learning, or software development.

**Bonus if you have the following:**

* A deep understanding of the DataCamp courses, assessments, and certifications.
* An extensive track record of building sophisticated AI systems and workflows.
* An understanding or interest in the current certification landscape in data and AI: how leading programs are structured, where they fall short, and what makes a credential respected by employers.

The goal is to power metagenomic devices using long-read sequencing technologies by building a comprehensive database of pathogen information to inform response. The database will comprise >400,00 paired high-quality long read sequences with comprehensive antimicrobial susceptibility profiles. Enabled by Oracle Inc.'s cloud-computing scale and security, the Pathogen Program is advancing toward certified diagnostic tools for deployment in laboratories, hospitals, and public health organisations worldwide.
