### Overview

We have a fantastic new opportunity in our IC Design Team for a Senior Physical Design Engineer! Forming a key part of our expanding Engineering function, this is a critical role which will have a high impact on the development of our next generation of products. Reporting to the Principal Engineer/Manager - Digital IC Design, you will have responsibility for technical ownership of digital implementation for our mixed-signal and RF semiconductor products; and will contribute directly to the company's core research, development, and commercial manufacturing activities.

We are looking for candidates with significant experience in Physical and Digital ASIC design, as well as the ability to collaborate cross-functionally in a highly effective manner. This is a vital role in a high-performing and supportive team, with the opportunity to learn/develop and make significant contributions.

We are able to offer Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance for this role. Ideally you will be based (or will be able to be based) in Cambridge, although we are happy to consider hybrid/remote applications, providing you are based in the UK.

### Key tasks

* Design and implement digital IC architectures at block and chip level for mixed-signal and RF applications
* Perform physical design activities, including floor-planning, placement, clock tree synthesis (CTS), routing, and timing closure
* Develop, maintain, and optimise digital design flows and methodologies to ensure efficient and consistent design delivery
* Analyse and resolve complex technical issues relating to performance, timing, power, and manufacturability
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (including analogue, RF, process, and product engineering) to ensure successful integration and delivery of semiconductor products
* Document design processes, methodologies, and results in accordance with engineering and regulatory standards
* Actively participate in design reviews and sign-off processes

### Qualifications and training

Bachelor’s/Master's Degree (or equivalent) in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline would be preferred; or equivalent professional experience that demonstrates advanced knowledge and expertise in ASIC design.

### Skills and experience

Essential:

* In-depth knowledge of digital ASIC design flows and methodologies, including:

* Simulation and verification
* Logic synthesis
* Place and route
* Clock tree synthesis (CTS)
* Parasitic extraction
* Static timing analysis (STA) and timing closure
* Power analysis
* Design-for-Test (DFT)
* Proven experience using industry-standard Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools (e.g., Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens EDA)
* Ability to apply advanced engineering principles to solve complex technical problems
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary engineering teams

Desirable:

* Experience in specifying, establishing, and maintaining digital design flows
* Proficiency in scripting/programming languages (e.g., Python, Shell)
* Experience with full-custom IC design techniques

* Strong understanding of Windows and UNIX-hosted applications and services.
* Experience with networking, DNS, Active Directory, DFS, PKI, LDAP, Kerberos and related infrastructure services.
* Database and application support experience across technologies such as MSSQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, IIS, Apache, Java, XML and SOAP.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across application, platform, network and infrastructure layers.

* Solaris 10, NISP, NIS+, ZFS Zones, SMB and SharePoint.

* NATO NIRIS, NIRIS, S2S/C2S, nICCLink, US GCCS, HeATS, GrATS and BOWMAN BITS.

* Contributing to the development and delivery of meaningful double materiality assessments.
* Shaping and delivering stakeholder engagement.
* Setting effective goals and targets.

Your work will mean that everyone in Liverpool will get to hear about what the council are doing in their name. If you’re a politically-minded reporter, ready to hold power to account in Liverpool, searching for brilliant and engaging stories for our audience then this is the position for you!

* You’ll be covering the key business of a variety of **Knowsley & Sefton councils**, as well as the political and social issues affecting their communities

## Job Description

Senior Campaign Manager — Industrial Automation

Location - UK, Coventry or Spain, Barcelona

Purpose of the role

Industrial Automation goes to market across a broad portfolio of end-market segments, each with its own buying group, economics and route to market. Buyers are becoming larger, more technical and do most of their evaluation before they speak to us — reaching us through distribution, system integrators, panel builders, OEMs, EPCs, consulting engineers and direct engagement.

This role owns integrated, segment-led campaigns across the full portfolio, with focus set by segment growth priorities and business need. You build the campaigns, deploy them through the right channel routes, and make them work in-country by enabling zone and country teams to run and improve them.

The distinguishing feature of the role is customer journey design and stress testing — pressure-testing journeys before and after launch, using AI-based simulation, intent signals and analytics to find where buyers stall, drop out or are handed off badly. We are early in applying AI to marketing and want someone who will help set the standard.

Key responsibilities

1. Segment campaign strategy:

Own and support the team's campaign plan across the segment portfolio, directing focus and investment to where growth priorities sit. Translate each segment's priorities into propositions with a clear commercial thesis — buying group, problem, offer, competitive displacement and measurement. Use and improve a reusable campaign framework so the portfolio scales without rebuilding each segment from scratch. Partner with segment leadership, offer marketing and pre-sales so campaigns reflect the real proposition, not a generic version.

2. Channel and route-to-market:

Design campaigns that are channel-native from the outset — distribution, system integrators, Alliance partners, OEMs, EPCs and direct routes each need different assets, incentives and measurement. Support partner-facing kits (co-brandable assets, demand-sharing, lead routing) that a partner can run with minimal marketing capability. Define clear rules for lead ownership and handover across direct and indirect routes, and fix where they break.

3. Customer journey creation and stress testing:

Design end-to-end journeys for each segment and channel, spanning awareness through specification, evaluation, quotation, purchase and expansion — built around real B2B buying with multiple stakeholders and no linear path. Stress test before launch using AI persona simulation, red-teaming and scenario testing. Enhance after launch by reviewing drop-off, dwell patterns, sequencing and hand-off latency. Run structured experimentation and own the feedback loop back into content, offer marketing and enablement.

4. AI systems and marketing technology:

Act as an early adopter and advocate for AI-enabled campaigns and journeys — content generation and localisation at scale, intent data and predictive scoring, journey orchestration and next-best-action, and simulation for pre-launch testing. Establish practical governance (what AI is used for, mandatory human review, brand and data protection). Build repeatable workflows country teams can use directly, so the capability scales.

5. Country enablement and enhancement:

Treat country teams as the primary customer of the role. Build genuinely deployable playbooks — audience definitions, sequencing, asset packs, localisation guidance, measurement templates and a "minimum viable deployment" for resource-constrained markets. Run enablement sessions, including hands-on AI workflow training. Establish a feedback route from countries into campaign design and act on it. Track adoption and quality by country and work directly with under-performing markets

6. Performance and governance:

Own campaign performance against pipeline, influenced revenue and journey-stage conversion — not activity metrics. Build measurement that works across direct and indirect routes and is honest about attribution limits. Report to leadership with clear recommendations, including what to stop. Manage campaign budget and vendor relationships.

About You

Essential

* Substantial B2B marketing experience owning integrated campaigns in complex, considered-purchase environments.
* Proven experience marketing into or through indirect channel routes, with real understanding of partner economics.
* Track record of segment or vertical marketing where the proposition differs by end market
* Hands-on customer journey mapping and optimisation, using data to find and fix failure points.
* Practical, current experience applying AI tools to marketing — able to describe specific workflows you have built.
* Strong martech fluency: marketing automation, CRM (Salesforce or equivalent), intent data, analytics and attribution.
* Experience influencing across a matrixed international organisation.
* Excellent written English, able to make technical propositions clear without diluting them.

Desirable

* Domain exposure to one or more Industrial Automation end markets.
* Familiarity with industrial automation, control systems, IIoT or adjacent categories.
* Experience with account-based marketing in long-cycle capital sales.
* Experience building enablement programmes for distributed regional teams.

##

**Group & UK Data Protection Officer**

**Location:** Flexible UK (Hybrid with regular travel to Hook and London)

**Shape the future of privacy across a global organisation**

Data is one of Serco's most valuable assets and protecting it is fundamental to the trust our customers, governments and millions of citizens place in us every day.

We're looking for an exceptional Group & UK Data Protection Officer (DPO) to provide independent oversight of data protection across our global business, while fulfilling the statutory responsibilities of the UK Data Protection Officer.

This is far more than a compliance role.

You'll help shape how privacy supports innovation across a business operating in defence, justice, transport, healthcare, citizen services and other critical public services. From emerging technologies and AI governance to complex international data transfers, you'll ensure privacy remains central to every decision we make. Operating independently, you'll advise and challenge senior leaders, influence strategic decisions and provide assurance that Serco continues to meet the highest standards of data protection and governance.

**A role with influence across the organisation**

Reporting with statutory independence, you'll work across Group functions and the UK business, partnering with executive leaders, legal, cyber security, digital, risk and operational teams to embed privacy into everything we do.

You'll shape our global privacy framework, provide oversight of UK data protection compliance and ensure privacy risks are understood, managed and reported effectively.

Whether advising on a major transformation programme, supporting the responsible adoption of AI, engaging with regulators or helping the business navigate evolving legislation, you'll play a critical role in protecting both individuals and Serco's reputation.

**What you'll be doing**

As Group & UK Data Protection Officer, you'll provide independent leadership across all aspects of privacy governance, including:

* Acting as Serco's statutory **UK Data Protection Officer** while providing strategic oversight of privacy across the wider Group.
* Developing and evolving Serco's global privacy framework, governance standards and assurance model.
* Advising senior leaders on complex privacy risks, regulatory requirements and emerging legislation.
* Providing independent oversight of Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and high-risk processing activities.
* Supporting major business change, digital transformation, supplier arrangements and AI-enabled solutions by embedding privacy by design.
* Leading the organisation's approach to personal data incidents, regulatory notifications and lessons learned.
* Acting as the principal point of contact with regulators, supervisory authorities and data subjects within your DPO remit.
* Monitoring organisational compliance through assurance activity, audits, reporting and governance reviews.
* Providing clear reporting to Executive leadership and governance forums on privacy performance, emerging risks and regulatory developments.

**Who we're looking for**

This is an opportunity for an experienced privacy leader who combines technical expertise with sound judgement, commercial awareness and the confidence to influence at the highest levels.

You'll bring:

* Extensive experience in a senior data protection, privacy, governance or compliance leadership role.

From protecting rivers and supporting biodiversity to enabling major capital investment and driving sustainability ambitions, your work will directly influence how we deliver for our customers and the environment.

Operating within our expert client team, you'll work alongside a trusted network of specialist planning consultants who prepare and submit planning applications on our behalf. As a Senior Town Planner, you'll provide strategic direction, technical expertise and commercial oversight to ensure planning and environmental consents are secured efficiently, on time and within budget.

Reporting to the Town Planning Manager, you'll be part of a team of planners and land professionals, collaborating with engineers, ecologists, land agents, legal specialists and project teams across the business.

Our typical planning activity includes:

* Ensuring we get maximum value from our permitted development rights.
* Improvements and extensions to existing operational sites.
* New Operational sites – small to big and often in sensitive locations.
* Strategic pipelines and associated above ground infrastructure.
* Network improvements including new assets to reduce spills to river and enhance environmental performance.

But you will also have opportunities to work on:

* Renewable energy projects and Net Zero initiatives.
* New accommodation requirements on and off the estate e.g. new depots and offices.
* Planning inputs to disposals of land and property.
* Supporting surveyors with Compulsory Purchase.
* Influencing National legislation and Guidance.
* Projects in National Parks, World Heritage Sites, Green Belt and Conservation areas.
* Heritage projects across the operational and non-operational estate.
* Support and inputs to project communications and stakeholder engagement strategies.
* Responding to third party applications that impact our operations or assets.
* Tender processes and assessment of supplier performance.
* Land and Planning standards, policies and procedures.

You'll collaborate with engineers, planning consultants, land agents, ecologists, legal teams and external stakeholders to help deliver major operational and non-operational projects. From small scale projects to nationally significant infrastructure schemes, development in sensitive locations, renewable energy projects or Biodiversity Net Gain initiatives, you'll help ensure projects are planned and delivered successfully while balancing environmental, regulatory and community considerations.   
  
  
You will help project teams navigate the EIA regulations and release/screen out projects for delivery on time and with proportionate levels of assessment. You will be expected to identify project risks and advise project teams on best courses of action and mitigation.

This varied role offers the opportunity to work across a broad range of planning matters, from developing planning strategies and securing consents to advising on legislation, project risks and planning policy. If you're looking for a role where your expertise will be valued, your influence will be visible and your projects will make a genuine difference to communities, customers and the environment, then we look forward to hearing from you.

You'll bring strong technical expertise in town planning and Environmental Impact Assessment, together with the ability to apply that knowledge across a broad and challenging portfolio of projects. You'll be confident navigating complex planning issues, balancing competing priorities and providing practical, commercially focused advice that supports successful project outcomes.

We're looking for someone who thrives on collaboration and enjoys building strong relationships with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders. You'll be an effective communicator, comfortable influencing decision-makers, managing competing interests and providing clear recommendations in often complex situations.

You'll hold a qualification in Town Planning and be a member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI). You will ideally have a minimum of five years of experience in a consultancy, local authority or client-side organisation/developer that regularly engages the planning system.

Most importantly, you'll be someone who enjoys solving problems, managing uncertainty and helping projects move forward. You'll have a proven ability to assess risk, develop pragmatic solutions and guide teams through challenges to achieve successful outcomes. Your ability to influence, build trust and drive progress will be key to your success in this role.

Skills and experience are important, but character, positivity, and a caring attitude matter too. We welcome and celebrate diverse individuals, knowing they help us better serve our communities. The 1st Team Lead Physical Performance Coach will lead the Physical Performance programme for the Women's First Team, overseeing physical performance delivery, profiling, testing, load monitoring, injury prevention and on-pitch rehabilitation support.

As a senior member of the multidisciplinary team, they will drive the ongoing development of the Club's physical performance provision, ensuring all programmes are aligned to the demands of elite women's football and maximise player performance and availability.

They will be motivated by the Club's footballing strategy of Out Run, Out Fight, Out Play, ensuring all physical performance strategies support the Club's Football Philosophy.

**Core Role Responsibilities:**

**Physical Performance Delivery**

* Design and deliver gym- and pitch-based physical sessions, working collaboratively with the wider MDT to ensure complementary and non-overlapping programming.
* Lead the planning and periodisation of physical preparation across pre-season, in-season, and transition phases, aligned to the coaching schedule and football demands.
* Design and deliver individualised physical development programmes for first-team players that enhance their ability to repeatedly perform high-intensity and explosive actions throughout matches and sustain physical performance across a competitive season.
* Lead on matchday preparation, activation, and post-match recovery protocols.
* Ensure physical programmes are aligned to the Club's football philosophy, the demands of elite women's football, and current evidence relating to female athlete development, physiology, injury risk factors and performance optimisation.
* Continually review, challenge and evolve physical performance practices through the application of emerging research, technology and evidence-informed methodologies.

**Profiling, Testing and Load Monitoring**

* Lead pre-season and in-season physical testing cycles and maintain up-to-date individual player physical profiles.
* Oversee external and internal load monitoring using GPS, heart rate, RPE, and wellness tools, ensuring data is collected consistently and actioned in a timely manner.
* Produce clear, accessible reports and summaries that inform coaching and medical staff decisions - familiarity with data visualisation tools is expected.
* Monitor training responses, flag risk, and adapt programmes based on player data and medical input.
* Utilise physical performance data to inform individual player development, identify performance opportunities and support evidence-based decision-making across the multidisciplinary team.
* Maintain accurate documentation of physical assessments, load data, and player progress within the club's athlete management system.

**Injury Prevention and Rehabilitation Support**  
In collaboration with the medical department:

* Lead the design and implementation of injury prevention, prehabilitation, movement preparation and activation strategies that enhance athlete robustness and maximise player availability.
* Contribute to return-to-train and return-to-play pathways, supporting criteria-based progression and physical re-integration.
* Analyse injury trends and physical performance data to inform long-term robustness programmes and proactive injury risk reduction strategies across the squad.
* Develop and oversee Individual Development Plans (IDPs), implementing targeted interventions to support physical development, movement quality and injury risk reduction.
* Liaise regularly with physiotherapy and sports medicine staff to ensure a coordinated approach to player management.

**Multidisciplinary Collaboration**

* Operate as a senior member of the first team MDT, building effective working relationships across coaching, medical, analysis and nutrition functions.
* Act as the primary physical performance point of contact within the first team, contributing to performance reviews, planning meetings, and player management discussions.
* Represent the department's physical performance provision to coaching staff and club leadership with clarity and confidence.
* Communicate player status, physical readiness, and training loads to the 1st Team Head Coach on an ongoing basis.

**Academy Pathway Oversight**

* Maintain a collaborative relationship with the Women's Academy physical performance staff to support coherent player transitions and consistency of physical development philosophy.
* Support the development of a club-wide physical performance framework that promotes consistency in athlete development principles and physical performance standards across the women's and girls' pathway.
* Act as a point of reference for the Academy on first team physical standards and expectations.

* Any other reasonable requests as directed by management.

* Report any concerns of discrimination to the relevant parties and promote a welcoming and inclusive club environment for all.
* Adhere to the Club's Equality, Diversity and Inclusion policies, supporting the Club to create an environment which is inclusive and all-encompassing.
* Carry out and actively participate in all training requests as directed by the Club, including mandatory health and safety training, emergency procedures, fire safety, manual handling, safeguarding, and role-specific safety instruction.

**Essential Requirements:**

* BSc or MSc in Strength and Conditioning, Sports Science or related discipline
* UKSCA Accredited Strength and Conditioning Coach (ASCC) or equivalent.
* FA Level 2 Emergency First Aid in Football (EFAiF).
* UKAD Introduction to Clean Sport.
* FA Safeguarding Children Certificate.
* Significant experience delivering physical performance support in elite professional sport.
* Proven ability to design and deliver individualised and squad-wide physical conditioning programmes, including the development and implementation of individual player development plans.
* Experience in player monitoring and workload management using GPS and internal load tools.
* Familiarity with data visualisation tools and athlete management systems (e.g. Catapult, STATSports, Teamworks, or equivalent).

OverviewApplication

## **Meet Siena**

Siena is the Agent of Record for consumer brands. One agent that owns the entire customer journey, running on a shared intelligence layer no point tool can replicate.

Consumer brands run ten or more disconnected tools to manage their customers. We collapse that stack into a single agent. It started with support, the hardest surface a brand has, and it expands from there: Shopping Agent, Social Agent, Siena working alongside a brand's own operators. One agent across every surface, with shared memory, shared context, and shared tools.

Hundreds of brands already run real customer volume on Siena in production. This is built, working, and growing, and we are racing to build what comes next.

## 

## **The team**

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to own real problems rather than close tickets, keep reading.

**About the role**

Our current Engineering Manager holds the full picture across Channels, Analytics, Agents, and Integrations. That context is bottlenecked in one person - and that's a problem we're close to feeling. We're scaling fast: Order Protection, Social Agent, Voice, and Shopping Agent are all spinning up in parallel. The team is distributed remotely across different timezones, making working hours and proper oversight hard to properly meet.

This role exists to close that gap. We need someone who owns engineering execution day-to-day - taking roughly 30% of what our Engineering Manager currently holds - so they can focus on strategy, customers, fundraising, and what's next.

This isn't a coordinator role. You run 1:1s, keep cycle cadence honest, write technical debt plans alongside engineers, unblock people before it becomes an escalation, and act as a genuine thought partner on the operational side. Scope changes and anything that reshapes the team are joint calls. Everything else is yours.

**What you'll do**

**Delivery (≈50% of your time):** Own the weekly cadence for Channels and Analytics. Our Engineering Leadership is out of the loop on day-to-day - but always knows what's happening. Work with PMs and engineering leadership to surface and sequence priorities - including the ones nobody has written down yet. Help organise backlogs and bring structure to teams operating in a fast-moving, low-process environment. Unblock engineers proactively. Identify the constraint before it becomes an escalation. Write and maintain technical debt plans with engineers, not for them. Act as a second thinker on integration strategy and capacity planning.

**Developer experience (≈25%):** Improve the things that slow good engineers down. You don't need permission to start. Bring structure where it adds speed, and resist adding process for its own sake.

**People development (≈25%):** Run 1:1s that leave engineers with clearer thinking, not just status logged. Deliver hard feedback directly. Have it land, not bruise. Help develop senior engineers who want to grow - including coaching engineers who have ambitions toward management. Act as a backup hiring partner: help run loops, hold the bar, partner with recruiting.

**What you'll bring**

* 3+ years managing engineers in a product-delivery capacity — you've owned outcomes, not just people
* Based in a European timezone (UTC to UTC+3) — this role exists specifically to be close to engineers our Engineering Manager can't reach from their timezone
* Startup or scale-up experience: you know what it feels like when there's no process and no safety net
* Technical credibility - not the best engineer in the room, but credible enough that senior engineers route hard problems to you, not around you
* Genuine AI/LLM fluency: you understand agentic systems, evals, and model reliability -` not just that "AI is changing everything"
* Experience with security, compliance, or SOC-adjacent work
* Worked in a product company without a dedicated TPM or staff engineer as a crutch
* Experience managing senior engineers who don't need managing in the traditional sense - they need a thought partner, not a process owner

**What we're not looking for**

* Someone who needs a fully defined process to operate
* Someone who comes in wanting to redesign the org or introduce career ladders before shipping anything
* Someone whose answer to "what did your team ship?" is "that was a PM call"
* Someone whose primary achievement track is headcount growth, org structures, or reporting lines
* Someone pitching a VP trajectory or dotted-line authority on day one

**What success looks like**

**Day 30:** You've run two 1:1 cycles with each engineer on the team. You own the Channels and Analytics weekly cadence - our engineering leadership is out of the loop, but understands what's happening. You've read the last quarter of Linear, mapped the codebase shape, and met every integration owner..

**Day 60:** One concrete unblock in Channels that wouldn't have happened without you owning the planning side - even if that means surfacing refactoring potential. The security compliance work (Sprinto) is no longer single-threaded through one person: documented, distributed, or sequenced behind a milestone date. You've been to a customer meeting or shadowed the deployment team on issues to be tackled.

**Day 90:** A measurable delivery attributes to your planning, not your coding. Engineers proactively bring you problems they used to escalate upward - and team channels have broader engineering discussions, not just siloed problems. That's the trust signal. Our current Engineering Manager has recovered roughly one full day a week of management overhead. You work as a unit: they handle strategy, customers, and exec conversations; you handle execution, 1:1s, planning, and day-to-day unblocking. Hiring, scope changes, and anything that reshapes the team are joint calls.

**Failure looks like:** status reports flowing through you with no judgment added; engineers being polite but routing around you; our current Engineering Manager still running teams in practice while you sit elsewhere.

## Why Siena?

* **Real ownership.** You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.
* **Work that ships and matters.** What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.
* **A category we are creating.** The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.
* **A team that respects your judgment.** Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.
* **Great salary plus equity or stock grants.** Own a piece of what you build.
* **Learning budget.** If you are growing, so are we.
* **AI-fluency by default.** Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

## **Our values**

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback—both giving and receiving it—because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

## **Our approach to AI**

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we’re not just looking for people who can do a job. We’re looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that’s you, we look forward to your application.

## About the Pro Bono team and Access to Justice Programme

Simmons & Simmons has a long history of providing free legal services to individuals, charities, NGOs and community organisations who would otherwise struggle to access legal support. The firm’s pro bono practice is managed centrally by the Pro Bono team and reflects the firm’s commitment to using its legal skills and resources to create positive social impact.

The firm’s dedicated Access to Justice Programme supports vulnerable individuals to challenge welfare benefits decisions, including disability benefit appeals. Clients are referred through frontline agencies such as law centres, advice agencies and charities. The programme provides end-to-end support, from initial instructions and appeal preparation through to written submissions and tribunal advocacy where appropriate.

The Programme is led and supervised by the Senior Pro Bono Lawyer, who provides training, supervision and specialist social welfare law expertise. # Head of Security Operations

**Head of Security Operations**  
You will own security operations at Sokin: build it, run it, and grow it. That covers detection strategy, incident response and management, vulnerability management, and identity governance, with day-to-day L1/L2 triage and a chunk of Sentinel content maintenance handled by an outsourced SOC/MSSP. The exact MSSP scope is still being finalized as part of a broader investment case, so you'll help shape the split between what the MSSP owns and what stays in-house as the function matures, rather than inheriting a fixed operating model.

This is not a queue-management role, and it's not a role where you sit above an MSSP and relay their output. You direct the detection strategy and hold the MSSP to a quality bar on the content they build and tune, you own L3 investigation and forensics, you run vulnerability management as a program rather than a scanner subscription, and you own identity governance and incident management end to end. Where the MSSP can't cover something - bespoke detections, payments/fraud-specific logic, judgment calls in an active incident - that's you.

**About Us**Sokin is a next-generation B2B financial services provider, enabling businesses to make and receive global payments with greater speed, lower cost, and total transparency.  
Our mission is simple: we’re simplifying global business - so businesses thrive wherever they choose to grow. We deliver services across:

• Global payments and receivables

• Foreign Exchange (FX)

• Treasury management

• Finance reconciliations

We are rapidly expanding, with established presence in EMEA, APAC, and North America, backed by a strong global infrastructure and industry-leading partners, we are redefining how businesses move money worldwide.

Our clients span industries from sports and entertainment to logistics and travel, and our community is growing rapidly. As we continue to expand, we’re building a team of exceptional people who share our ambition to transform the future of global payments.

**What you'll do**

**Detection strategy & engineering**

* Define and maintain the detection strategy, mapped to **MITRE** **ATT&CK** and iterated against real incidents and threat intel, not left as a static framework exercise
* Set the standards and review bar for **Microsoft Sentinel** content (detection rules, analytics, workbooks, Logic Apps playbooks) whether authored by the MSSP or in-house, and own detection-as-code practices - version control, peer review, testing - for that content
* Own the detections the MSSP can't reasonably build: bespoke, payments/fraud-specific, or identity-driven logic
* Onboard new log sources and systems into the detection pipeline as the platform evolves, and integrate **Defender** **XDR****, Wiz, Cloudflare, Zscaler**, and other tooling as it's added, including email/data security telemetry (Defender for O365, DLP) once in scope
* Consume threat intelligence (feeds, ISACs, sector-specific sources) and translate it into detection and hunting priorities rather than treating it as a subscription nobody reads
* Build and maintain SOAR automation for alert enrichment, triage, and response actions, so the function scales with the estate rather than with headcount

**MSSP** **& outsourced SOC**

* Own the MSSP/outsourced SOC relationship end to end: SLAs, triage quality, playbook tuning, and contract renewal or rescoping as the function's needs change
* Actively shape the boundary between MSSP and in-house scope as the team and platform mature, rather than treating today's split as permanent

**Incident response & management**

* Lead incident response: own L3 investigation and forensic analysis across cloud and endpoint, working from MSSP escalations and your own detections
* Own incident management end to end alongside the CISO - major incident declaration, exec/board notification, and coordination with legal/comms on regulatory notification clocks (GDPR 72-hour, DORA incident classification and reporting) - not just the technical investigation
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and runbooks, and test them regularly through tabletop exercises rather than leaving them filed and unverified
* Drive post-incident reviews and RCAs, and feed lessons back into detection and playbook updates

**Vulnerability management & identity governance**

* Own vulnerability management as a program: scanning coverage across cloud, endpoint, and applications, risk-based prioritization, remediation SLAs, and exception handling with named owners
* Own identity governance within security operations: privileged access monitoring, access anomaly detection, joiner/mover/leaver assurance from a security lens, and identity-related detection coverage across Entra ID/Okta and cloud IAM

**Metrics, team, and reporting**

* Own MTTD, MTTR, and other operational metrics: baseline them, track them, and drive them down
* Manage the security operations team, including direct line management of the Security Analyst, and build the hiring/leveling plan as team and MSSP scope evolve
* Manage SOC systems, tooling, and processes end to end, including budget and licensing conversations with the CISO
* Support the CISO on incident communication, board/customer reporting, and post-incident reviews

**What we're looking for**

**Essential:**

* Deep Microsoft Sentinel experience: KQL proficient, able to author and critically review detection rules, workbooks, and playbooks, even where day-to-day content maintenance sits with a third party
* Experience onboarding new data sources into a SIEM and scaling detection coverage as an environment grows
* Hands-on incident response and digital forensics experience across cloud and endpoint, including running an incident through containment, eradication, and RCA, not just triage
* Experience sharing ownership of the incident management process: major incident declaration, exec communication, and regulatory notification timelines (GDPR, DORA, or equivalent), typically alongside a CISO or equivalent
* Applied MITRE ATT&CK knowledge used in detection engineering, not just framework familiarity
* Experience running or managing vulnerability management as a program: tooling, prioritization, remediation tracking, and reporting
* Working knowledge of identity governance and access risk (privileged access, JML, IAM/entitlement review) as it applies to security operations
* Experience managing an MSSP/outsourced SOC relationship, including SLAs, contract or scope negotiation, and holding a third party accountable for quality
* Experience running tabletop exercises or equivalent IR plan testing
* Cloud security telemetry: AWS CloudTrail, Azure Monitor, GCP audit logs
* Strong written communication for incident reports and RCAs aimed at non-technical readers

**Nice to have:**

* Prior people management or mentoring experience in a SOC or detection engineering team
* Experience with Defender XDR (Defender for Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps)
* Wiz or equivalent CSPM integration into detection pipelines
* Fintech, payments, or regulated environment background
* Formal threat intelligence platform experience (beyond consuming feeds)
* Python or PowerShell for automation
* Certifications (valued, not required): SC-200, AZ-500, GCIA, GCIH, GCFE, GCFA, or equivalent applied experience

**Why this role**

Real ownership of security operations from day one, with direct CISO access and a mandate to define - not just inherit - the split between an outsourced SOC and in-house engineering as the function scales. You'll build detection strategy, IR, vulnerability management, and identity governance as one coherent function, with real influence over how the operating model is shaped.

* Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline management, and opportunity tracking.
* Achieve recruitment, pipeline, and revenue objectives aligned to territory goals.

* Partner-generated pipeline growth.

* Expansion of strategic existing partner relationships.
* Increased market coverage across priority EMEA regions

Field-oriented control (FOC) experience.
Familiarity with gRPC or other distributed software architectures.
Experience working in Agile teams.
A degree in electronics, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

## Overview

Role

StarCompliance is seeking a Lead Design Engineer – AI Product Experience who will shape how user experiences are designed, prototyped, and delivered across our engineering organisation. This role is responsible for bringing together user experience design, frontend engineering, and AI-assisted development to create scalable product experience standards that can be consistently applied by both engineers and AI agents.

This is not a traditional UX design or UI engineering role. The successful candidate will operate as a highly technical, hands-on design engineering leader focused on evolving our design system for agentic consumption, creating working prototypes in place of static design handovers, and ensuring that accessibility, usability, and consistency are embedded directly into our frontend foundations.

The role will work closely with Software Engineering, Product, Architecture, Platform Engineering, and AI Enablement teams to establish reusable components, interaction patterns, agent instructions, and governance that support faster, more consistent, and increasingly autonomous product delivery.

How We Think About AI

At StarCompliance, AI is not a side experiment or an isolated specialist capability. We treat it as a foundational part of modern software engineering and SaaS platform development.

We expect engineers to:

* Actively use AI-assisted engineering tools as part of their daily workflows.

* Apply AI to improve design quality, development velocity, automation depth, operational insight, and overall engineering effectiveness.

* Ensure AI-generated outputs are validated, auditable, and compliant with security, privacy, and regulatory standards.

### Key Responsibilities

**Design System & Frontend Foundations**

+ Own the strategy, architecture, and ongoing evolution of StarCompliance’s enterprise design system, ensuring it supports consistent delivery across products and teams.

+ Develop the design system into an AI-consumable platform that can be reliably used by engineers, coding assistants, and autonomous development agents.

+ Define reusable components, design tokens, interaction patterns, application layouts, and accessibility standards.

+ Create clear documentation, examples, constraints, and validation mechanisms that enable reliable agent-generated user interfaces.

+ Maintain alignment between the design system, shared frontend foundations, and StarCompliance’s wider technical architecture.

**Design Engineering & Prototyping**

+ Translate product opportunities, user needs, and business requirements into working prototypes rather than relying on static design handovers.

+ Use code and AI-assisted development tools to create realistic product experiences that can be tested and refined with users.

+ Work with Product, customers, subject matter experts, and engineers to explore workflows, validate solutions, and improve concepts before production delivery.

+ Define interaction models for complex compliance workflows, data-intensive applications, and AI-enabled product capabilities.

**Agentic Product Development**

+ Define how AI agents should interpret product intent and generate user interfaces using approved components and experience standards.

+ Create and maintain agent instructions, reference implementations, rules, and machine-readable context for frontend development.

+ Partner with AI Enablement and Engineering teams to embed design system knowledge into agentic development workflows.

+ Establish governance for agent-generated interfaces, including accessibility validation, visual regression testing, and component conformance.

+ Review agent outputs and improve the components, guidance, and context required to produce reliable results.

**Product Experience & Accessibility**

+ Ensure user-centred design principles remain embedded within an increasingly automated software development process.

+ Champion accessible and inclusive design, ensuring accessibility requirements are built into components, patterns, and automated validation.

+ Use customer feedback, product analytics, usability evaluation, and telemetry to improve product experiences.

+ Ensure delivery speed does not come at the expense of usability, consistency, maintainability, or user trust.

**Technical Leadership & Governance**

+ Lead the Design System Forum, bringing together Product, Engineering, and Architecture to govern shared standards and prioritise the continued evolution of the design system.

+ Lead and develop a blended team of UI Engineers across permanent and consultancy partner resources, with responsibility for performance, workload allocation, delivery, and capability development.

+ Act as StarCompliance’s technical authority for design engineering and frontend experience, providing hands-on guidance and representing the discipline within relevant governance forums.

+ Coach Product Managers and engineers in prototype-led discovery, AI-assisted development, and the effective use of shared frontend foundations.

### Skills and Experience

+ Strong background in design engineering, frontend engineering, or user experience design.

+ Hands-on experience building modern React and TypeScript applications.

+ Experience creating or governing enterprise design systems, including component architecture, design tokens, and interaction patterns.

+ Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools and supporting agentic software delivery workflows.

+ Strong understanding of accessibility, inclusive design, and working prototype development.

+ Strong stakeholder communication, technical leadership, and people management capability.

### Desirable Skills

+ Experience within SaaS, enterprise, or regulated software environments.

+ Knowledge of Storybook, visual regression testing, automated accessibility testing, and frontend quality tooling.

+ Experience managing permanent employees and consultancy partner resources.

+ Familiarity with product analytics, usability testing, and behavioural telemetry.

**Job Overview**

The Creative Studio Traffic Manager is the day-to-day engine that keeps creative work moving through the studio with clarity, pace and discipline.

Working closely with the Creative Studio Manager, this role focuses on the live flow of work: taking briefs into the studio, shaping schedules, assigning tasks, tracking progress, resolving bottlenecks and making sure deadlines, expectations and handovers are clear.

Where the Creative Studio Manager owns the broader operating model, capacity planning and studio performance, the Creative Studio Traffic Manager brings that model to life every day by coordinating the movement of projects, people and information across creative, client services, production and delivery teams.

You’ll be highly organised, proactive and calm under pressure, able to see the detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. You’ll enjoy being the person who knows what is happening, what is coming next and what needs to be unblocked to keep great creative work on track.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Workflow & Job Traffic*

* Manage the daily flow of creative jobs through the studio from brief intake to final delivery.
* Triage new briefs, clarify requirements and ensure the right information is in place before work enters the studio.
* Build and maintain live schedules, task lists and status updates across active creative projects.
* Coordinate daily and weekly traffic meetings, ensuring actions, priorities and blockers are clearly captured and followed up.
* Monitor progress against deadlines and proactively flag risks to delivery, quality or resource availability.

*Resource Coordination*

* Support the Creative Studio Manager in allocating creative resource based on skills, availability, deadlines and project priorities.

**Who we are**

Chefs in Schools is a young, ambitious charity that’s rapidly growing. Our mission is to improve kids' health, through improving school food & food education.

We focus our efforts in areas of high socio-economic deprivation, where more than a third of children are entitled to free school meals, and diet-related disease is driving further inequality.

We support and train school kitchen teams to serve the best, freshest and tastiest food possible, alongside meaningful food education. We share learning and resources, aiming to inspire and enable others to follow our lead.

We’re backed by some of the biggest names in food and have ambitious targets to ensure every child has access to incredible school food and food education, setting them up for life with the skills and knowledge to feed themselves well.

**About you and the role**

You are a pragmatic, highly analytical data professional who lives at the intersection of charity compliance and modern cloud systems. You are someone who understands that a rapidly growing £2m charity needs lean, workable frameworks, not corporate red tape that stalls delivery.

You bring a strong track record of working within the UK non-profit sector, meaning you already understand the nuances of donor data, PECR regulations, and charity-specific workflows. You don’t just write policy documents; you enjoy untangling data flows and translating complex regulatory requirements into practical, everyday processes.

In this interim role, you will act as the "Product Owner" and "Information Governor" for our systems upgrade. You won't need to do the technical database configuration—we already have a trusted, external Beacon CRM expert to handle the builds. Instead, you will bridge the gap between our teams and the technology. You will run discovery sessions with our Fundraising, Programmes, Finance and Operations teams to map their operational needs, translate these into a compliant data blueprint, and drive our Beacon expert to build them.

Crucially, you won’t need to draft our Data Sharing Agreements (DSAs)—these are already in place. Your job is to audit our systems and processes to ensure we are physically complying with them, designing the exact workflows, access permissions, and data retention schedules needed to keep us airtight. Finally, you will advise us on how to sustainably own our data protection internally going forward.

#### **Who are we?**

Hi, we’re Tails.com – we turn good days into great years for dogs and their humans.

We're working towards longer lives for millions of healthy, happy dogs by providing tailored nutrition that adapts to each dog’s unique needs. It all starts with a few simple questions about their age, breed, zoomie level and tastebuds. From there, owners can create a personalised meal plan that's delivered to their door every month. **Job Title**

Head of Innovation & Range

**Reporting of the role**

This role reports to the Brand & Innovation Director

**Overview of the job**

The food we make is one of the most important ways customers experience Tails. Every recipe, treat and supplement we create has the power to strengthen our relationship with customers, improve the lives of dogs and set us apart in an increasingly competitive category.

As Head of Innovation & Range, you’ll shape where our range goes next. You’ll define our long-term innovation strategy, lead the development of new products and continuously improve the products our customers already love. Partnering across Brand, Marketing, Digital Product, Proposition, Trading, Finance and Operations and our key supplier partners you’ll turn customer insight into meaningful innovation that delivers commercial growth while keeping Tails at the forefront of personalised meal plans including our 100% tailored kibble blends.

This isn’t a traditional Head of NPD role. It’s an opportunity to shape the future of one of the UK’s most distinctive D2C consumer brands, creating products that improve the lives of dogs while helping more customers discover why tailored nutrition matters.

**3 best things about the job**

Shape one of the world’s most tailored food ranges:

* Every dog is different: You’ll help decide what we create next, how our range evolves and how we continue delivering genuinely tailored nutrition for all dogs at scale.  
  You’ll have real influence: From long-term innovation strategy to the products customers receive every month, you’ll work across the business to shape decisions that matter for our customers and their dogs, our brand and our commercial performance.
* Build what’s next: The foundations are in place. This is an opportunity to lead the next chapter of innovation at Tails, strengthening our capability, developing an exciting pipeline and building products that keep us ahead in a fast-moving category.

**Measures of success – In the first few months, you would have:**

* Built strong relationships across Brand, Marketing, Digital Product, Proposition, Trading, Finance and Operations and our key supplier partners, plus corporate stakeholders.
* Taken a fresh look at our current range strategy and 12–24 month pipeline, identifying opportunities to strengthen both renovation and innovation.
* Become confident in our product development process, including our stage gate and claims (IRAQ) framework.
* Developed a clear point of view on where our innovation efforts should focus over the next three to five years.
* Started evolving the capability of the team, ensuring we have the skills, structure and ways of working needed to deliver our ambitions.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Innovation Strategy**

* Develop and own the long-term strategy for the Tails range, identifying where we should innovate, where we should renovate and where we should simplify. Use customer insight, nutritional science, commercial understanding and market trends to build a balanced innovation pipeline that strengthens our proposition and supports sustainable growth.
* Always be looking ahead - understanding changing customer needs, emerging ingredients and new technologies, then translating those insights into products customers genuinely value.

**Portfolio & Range Development**

* Own the ongoing health of the Tails range, ensuring every product continues to earn its place. Use customer feedback, commercial performance, nutritional science and operational insight to identify where products should be improved, simplified, expanded or retired.
* Lead our renovation programme with the same ambition we bring to innovation, continually improving recipes, formats and customer experience so the range remains relevant, differentiated and commercially strong.

**Innovation Delivery**

* Own our innovation pipeline from first insight through to launch and beyond.
* Prioritise opportunities, guide cross-functional teams and make thoughtful trade-offs that balance customer benefit, technical feasibility, operational complexity and commercial return.
* Continuously improve how we develop products, ensuring our processes help teams move efficiently while maintaining the high standards our customers expect.

**Commercial Performance**

* Partner closely with our Commercial teams to understand how our range is performing and where the greatest opportunities lie.
* Use customer feedback, commercial data and post-launch learning to improve existing products, refine future innovation and build compelling business cases for investment.
* Take shared accountability for the long-term health of the range, balancing customer value with commercial performance

**Leadership & Capability**

* Lead, coach and develop a high-performing innovation team that combines curiosity, commercial thinking and technical expertise.
* Create an environment where people feel empowered to challenge assumptions, learn quickly and continually raise the standard of our products.
* Continue evolving how we work with supplier partners, ensuring strong relationships, clear accountability and a shared ambition to deliver outstanding products for our customers.

**What you will need:**

* Significant experience leading innovation, range strategy or product development within FMCG, food, nutrition or another consumer products business.
* A track record of building products and innovation pipelines that have delivered meaningful customer value and commercial growth.
* Experience managing an established product portfolio, balancing long-term innovation with continuous improvement of existing products.
* Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to move comfortably between long term vision and day-to-day delivery.
* A deep understanding of how customer insight, commercial performance and technical capability come together to create successful products.
* Ideally you have experience working in a business where nutritional, health or regulated claims are important.
* Excellent commercial judgement, with experience building business cases, prioritising investment and managing product performance.
* Experience leading and developing high-performing teams.
* The ability to influence confidently across technical, commercial and creative disciplines.
* Comfortable working at pace, making informed decisions with imperfect information and adapting as you learn.
* An understanding of how a physical product can form part of a broader proposition, with digital and service elements too.

* Experience in a D2C, subscription or e-commerce business.
* Experience working with highly personalised products or services.

# **Construction Director at The Crown Estate**

**Purpose of Role**

At The Crown Estate, our purpose is to create lasting and shared prosperity for the nation. As Construction Director, you will provide strategic leadership across a complex portfolio of development projects, ensuring construction activity is delivered safely, sustainably, efficiently and to the highest standards.

Reporting to the Head of Delivery and Programme Management, you will lead the construction agenda across our Urban Development portfolio, shaping delivery strategy, governance, assurance and best practice from early feasibility through to completion and post-project learning. You will play a critical role in protecting long-term asset value, delivering positive outcomes for customers and communities, and embedding our commitment to safety, sustainability and responsible stewardship.

**Context of Opportunity / Main Accountabilities**

Working across a diverse portfolio of projects, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including Development, Design, Programme Management, Sustainability, Finance, Legal, Procurement and Health & Safety to ensure exceptional delivery outcomes.

Key responsibilities include:

* Providing leadership for construction delivery across the Urban Development portfolio, establishing strategy, standards, governance and assurance frameworks.
* Championing a best-in-class safety culture, ensuring health, safety and wellbeing remain at the forefront of every project and decision.
* Overseeing programme, cost, risk and quality performance across multiple projects, driving certainty of delivery and proactive risk management.

Totara is a global learning platform trusted by more than 1,500 organisations and 21 million users worldwide. **About the role**

This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of Totara's cloud platform.

Historically, our software has been released annually and deployed in a variety of ways by both Totara and our partners. Today, we're evolving towards operating our platform as a modern SaaS service: continuously delivered, consistently operated, and available wherever our customers need us around the world.

We're clear on where we're heading, but how we get there is still being built. As Head of Cloud Platform Engineering, you'll play a central role in defining that journey.

Today our infrastructure capability spans multiple teams, regions, and platforms, including environments inherited through acquisition. These teams have built valuable expertise, and your role will be to bring them together behind a shared operating model, common engineering standards, and a platform that enables our product teams to move faster with confidence.

You'll lead the teams responsible for how we provision, deploy, operate, observe, secure, and optimise the infrastructure that supports our global customer base.

Unlike many SaaS businesses, our customers run on dedicated deployments rather than shared multi-tenant infrastructure. Operating thousands of isolated environments efficiently, securely, and economically is one of the most interesting challenges this role will tackle.

Today we're primarily AWS-based, with multi-cloud capability becoming an important next step. Our customers include governments and highly regulated organisations with specific regional, sovereignty, and compliance requirements, so expanding our cloud footprint is driven by genuine customer need rather than technology for technology's sake.

**What you'll be responsible for:**

**Bringing teams together**

* Build a unified operating model across our infrastructure and cloud engineering teams.
* Establish shared engineering standards, on-call practices, and ways of working.
* Champion engineering excellence across infrastructure as code, peer review, operational readiness, and change management.
* Build, coach, and develop a high-performing distributed team.

**Building a scalable platform**

* Own the platform capabilities that enable engineering teams to provision, deploy, and operate services without reinventing infrastructure.
* Define and improve our service reliability through clear SLOs, recovery objectives, and operational practices.
* Make observability a core part of every platform capability, with logging, metrics, tracing, and operational runbooks built in from the start.
* Continuously reduce operational toil through automation, self-service, and self-healing systems so that growth doesn't require proportional operational effort.

**Modernising our infrastructure**

* Lead the infrastructure migration towards our target operating model through incremental, low-risk delivery.
* Develop repeatable, automated lifecycle management for our dedicated customer deployments, with clear isolation and resilience built in.

**Cloud architecture and cost**

* Own the architecture, security, resilience, and operational effectiveness of our AWS estate.
* Embed FinOps into everyday engineering decisions, helping us understand and improve the economics of operating our SaaS platform at scale.

**Security and compliance**

* Work closely with security and engineering leaders to ensure our platform is secure, compliant, and resilient by default.
* Support the evidence, auditability, and regional data residency requirements expected by enterprise, government, and regulated customers.

**Multi-cloud strategy**

* Lead our expansion into additional cloud providers where customer requirements make this necessary.
* Build portability where it adds genuine value, while keeping the platform pragmatic and avoiding unnecessary complexity.

**What success looks like:**

**Within your first six months**

* Infrastructure teams are working within a shared operating model, with common standards and on-call practices.
* A clear, costed, phased migration plan is agreed and early delivery is underway.
* Executive reporting includes meaningful visibility of service reliability and cloud unit economics.

**Within your first year**

* Automated provisioning and lifecycle management for our target platform is operating successfully in production.
* Operational effort grows significantly more slowly than our customer base.
* The platform engineering organisation is working as one team with a strong engineering culture and consistently high standards.

**W****hat we're looking for:**

We're looking for someone who combines deep technical expertise with thoughtful leadership and a passion for building great engineering organisations. You'll likely bring experience including:

* Leading platform or infrastructure engineering within a growing B2B SaaS business.
* Deep hands-on AWS expertise across infrastructure as code (such as Terraform), containers, orchestration, networking, and cloud security.
* Experience designing and operating dedicated customer or cell-based deployment models, with a strong understanding of isolation, resilience, and operational economics.
* A strong Site Reliability Engineering mindset, including service levels, incident management, observability, and operational excellence.
* Practical FinOps experience, with a track record of improving cloud cost efficiency.
* Leading and growing distributed engineering teams across multiple locations, including bringing together teams following organisational change or acquisition.
* Experience working within regulated industries where security, compliance, and governance are fundamental design considerations.
* Real-world experience delivering multi-cloud platforms, with good judgement about when portability genuinely adds value.

**It would be great if you also have**

* Experience transitioning products from hosted or self-managed deployments to fully managed SaaS.
* Experience building platforms or ecosystems that enable partners or third parties to extend products.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, FedRAMP, IRAP, or similar.

**Why Join Totara?**

* Lead a strategic function with strong executive support.
* Shape the future of security, trust and resilience for a global SaaS platform.
* Work with talented colleagues across New Zealand, Australia, the UK and the US.
* Flexible and hybrid ways of working.

VDC Operations Department is responsible for delivering the contractual SLAs to our customers, which comprises having ownership of any activity that takes place in the data center, ensuring the health of all its mechanical and electrical systems, carrying out/coordinating/managing building maintenance as well as any projects affecting the operational data center and ensuring the performance of all data modules

Lead EMEA regional execution of procurement-led operating services and lifecycle supply chain support for data center infrastructure. This role acts as the regional commercial and supply chain partner to Data Center Operations, Regional COOs, and site operating teams, enabling reliable, secure, and cost-efficient operations through supplier frameworks, service agreements, regional execution plans, and performance governance.

The Director is accountable for EMEA execution of maintenance, service delivery, security, spares, asset lifecycle, issue resolution, supplier escalation, and failure response frameworks. This role ensures regional suppliers and internal supply chain capabilities meet operational uptime, compliance, and customer SLA requirements while supporting global standards and adapting them to EMEA country, site, and regulatory requirements. * EMEA regional accountability for procurement and supply chain–enabled data center operating services supporting regional operations teams.

* Primary stakeholder interface with Data Center Operations, Regional COOs, and site leadership.

* Governance of supplier performance frameworks, including QBRs, SBRs, and KPI tracking.

* Ownership of EMEA critical spares strategies, emergency response frameworks, supplier escalation protocols, and service readiness.

* Regional leadership for supplier issue resolution, commercial dispute support, failure response coordination, and corrective action tracking.

* Oversight of security procurement, including manpower and technical systems.

* Responsibility for asset lifecycle management, including equipment EoL, recycling, and refurbishment.

* Enablement of asset tracking and lifecycle visibility systems.

* Procurement and supply chain support for small expansions and in-life capital works.

**Job Duties**

**Operations-Facing Procurement Partnership:**

* Act as the primary procurement and supply chain partner to:  Data Center Operations teams & Regional COOs and operating leadership.

* Translate operational requirements into commercial frameworks, supplier strategies, and service delivery models.

* Ensure procurement solutions are aligned to:  uptime expectations, operational constraints, regional execution realities.

**Global Service Agreements & Contracting**

* Support global master service agreement frameworks where applicable and lead EMEA regional supplier negotiations, contract localization, and execution for:  maintenance providers, facilities management, security services, specialized technical services.

* Embed clear service definitions, SLAs, escalation structures, and accountability mechanisms into all contracts.

* Balance global standardization with EMEA regional flexibility to support local operating models, country requirements, and site execution realities.

* Lead regional commercial negotiations with suppliers to resolve performance issues, scope gaps, service failures, claims, and escalation events.

* Drive commercial strategies that optimize:  cost, performance, and risk allocation.

**Supplier Performance Management (QBRs / SBRs)**

* Establish and lead structured supplier governance models, including:  Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs).

* Define and track KPIs across:  availability and uptime, response and recovery times, SLA compliance, quality and service delivery.

* Drive continuous improvement with suppliers, leveraging performance data, benchmarking, and contractual levers.

* Ensure transparent reporting, issue escalation, corrective action ownership, and alignment with Operations and COO leadership across EMEA.

* Drive supplier recovery plans for recurring service failures, underperformance, and operational disruptions, including commercial remedies where appropriate.

**Repair & Maintenance (R&M) and Preventative Maintenance (PM)**

* Own EMEA regional procurement execution for R&M and PM services.

* Ensure contracts enforce:  defined response times, recovery SLAs, preventative maintenance schedules.

* Coordinate supplier response to maintenance failures, missed service windows, and urgent repair events, ensuring recovery actions are documented and closed.

* Align maintenance frameworks with: OEM standards, asset criticality, operational uptime objectives.

**Critical Spares & Supply Chain Readiness**

* Execute EMEA regional strategy for critical spare parts, including: Inventory strategies and stocking models and Supplier frameworks and rapid fulfillment capabilities.

* Partner with Operations to align spares with: failure risk, lead times, site-level needs.

* Balance working capital efficiency with uptime protection.

**Emergency Response & Incident Support**

* Ensure EMEA procurement frameworks enable 24/7 emergency response capability across all critical systems.

* Contractually define, based on Operations requirements:  response SLAs, escalation pathways, recovery commitments.

* Support Operations in major incident and failure response scenarios through supplier mobilization, escalation management, commercial leverage, and contractual enforcement.

* Lead regional supplier issue resolution after failures, including root-cause follow-up, corrective action plans, recovery commitments, and lessons learned integration into future contracts.

**Customer SLA Alignment**

* Ensure customer-facing SLAs are fully embedded into:  supplier contract and service delivery frameworks.

* Partner with Operations to ensure:  external commitments are achievable and risks are mitigated through supply chain design.

* Drive alignment between customer expectations and supplier performance.

* Physical security manpower (guarding, access control personnel).

* Oversee sourcing and lifecycle management of technical security systems, including:  CCTV and surveillance infrastructure, access control systems, software licensing and upgrades.

* Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements.

**Equipment Lifecycle (EoL) Management & Recycling**

* Execute EMEA frameworks for equipment end-of-life (EoL) and lifecycle transitions.

* Manage programs for:  recycling and responsible disposal & reuse and refurbishment where viable.

* Ensure compliance with regulatory and sustainability requirements.

* Integrate EoL considerations into:  supplier contract, total cost of ownership models, long-term capacity and service strategies.

**Asset Tracking & Lifecycle Visibility**

* Enable and govern systems for:  asset tracking and registries, configuration management, maintenance service history integration.

* Ensure alignment between:  procurement systems, operational asset data, service providers.

* Support Operations with accurate, real-time asset visibility to improve:  maintenance planning, spares management, and lifecycle decision making.

**Small Expansions & In-Life Capital Support**

* Provide procurement and supply chain support for:  capacity expansions & equipment upgrades and retrofits.

* Ensure supplier frameworks enable: fast execution, minimal disruption to live operations, standardization and compliance.

**Performance, Cost & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives across: supplier performance, commercial frameworks, service delivery models
