job_description:
Are you passionate about making a significant impact on one of our generation's most pressing environmental challenges? Do you have the expertise to look at a parcel of land in Germany, Ireland or Iberia and know — before anyone else does — what will kill the project? Join us in creating and leading a new category in the Climate Tech industry.

About Waterplan

Waterplan is a pioneering Series A Y Combinator-backed Climate Tech startup dedicated to accelerating the journey toward a water-secure future. Through our leading B2B Enterprise SaaS platform, we empower companies to understand, respond, report, and monitor their ever-evolving water risk. We help businesses see the tangible benefits of mitigating water risks – fostering a future where organizations are motivated to conserve water and preserve our precious ecosystems.

Civarea, our AI-powered site selection platform for data centers, applies that same rigor to the fastest-growing infrastructure market in the world. We compress 30 days of fragmented site due diligence into same-day risk visibility: 280+ factors per site across power, permitting, water, environmental, community, connectivity and legal — used today by some of the largest DC operators and hyperscalers in the world. We're looking for a Data Center Site Selection Expert to be the expert eye between our AI engine and the client.

Every site assessment (SDC — Site Data Collection) and screening report we deliver passes through an expert review step. That step is you. You never face clients: your job is to make sure that what reaches them would survive the scrutiny of a VP of Site Acquisition who knows that region personally.

This is a high-impact role that combines technical judgment, regional depth, and speed. Your corrections don't just fix one report — they feed back into the engine, so your work compounds with every site you review.

One hard rule: the 12-hour turnaround. Our clients send us a site and expect it to be evaluated by the next morning. Every review must be completed within 12 hours of assignment, often overnight in European time. You choose your active days; within them, the 12 hours are the contract. If you can't commit to that response window, this isn't the right fit — and we'd rather be direct about it now.

What You'll Do

 * Review AI-generated SDCs and screening reports for European Data Centers sites before delivery — typically 1–2 hours per site, inside the 12-hour window.
 * Validate site-specificity: every key finding must be true for this parcel — this municipality, this utility, this grid node — not generic to the country or region.
 * Verify the power picture: grid operator identification (TSO/DSO), connection context, and known constraint zones.
 * Verify permitting and legal: zoning, environmental permitting pathways, the authority landscape, and realistic timelines for that jurisdiction.
 * Red-team the Top 5 risks. Try to break them, and flag anything overstated, understated or missing — community sentiment, flight paths, wetlands, protected areas.
 * Correct scores with a one-line justification each. These corrections train the engine.
 * Flag better local data sources when you know them: registries, cadastres, grid maps, local media.
 * Contribute your expert read to the internal self-review when a client challenges an assessment.

 * 3–6 years of experience in data center site selection or technical due diligence, ideally at a consultancy (Arup, Jacobs, Linesight, Turner & Townsend, CBRE's DC practice or similar) or inside a DC developer's site acquisition team.
 * Hands-on knowledge of the European landscape: grid operators (TenneT, Amprion, 50Hertz, National Grid, REE, RTE…) and permitting frameworks in at least 2–3 of DE / IE / UK / Nordics / Iberia / NL.
 * A real feel for how community and environmental factors kill sites, not just how they get scored.
 * You've reviewed reports for a living. You know the difference between a finding and a filler sentence.
 * Exceptionally detail-oriented and independent. You work unsupervised against a clock and you don't let things slip.
 * Fluent written English. German, French or Spanish is a plus, as is hyperscaler or colo exposure, GIS familiarity, and fiber & connectivity know-how.
 * Able to hold a 12-hour SLA against European delivery mornings, from any location.

The Engagement

Contract: hourly: 45-70 USD per hour depending on experience and site complexity.

Volume of ~5–15 sites per week and growing with our pilot pipeline, at roughly 1–2 hours per site. You set your active days and we assign within them.

We start with a paid trial: you review 2 real SDCs under the real 12-hour SLA, and we compare your notes against known ground truth. If it clicks, we ramp immediately.

Why Join Waterplan

Impactful Mission: Contribute to a meaningful cause with a clear vision of fostering a water-secure future.
Dynamic Team: Work alongside a talented and passionate team dedicated to making a difference.
Growth Opportunity: Be at the forefront of our industry's growth, shaping how the world's largest data centers get sited.
Culture & Values: Enjoy a fully remote working environment, rooted in our core values:
I dive in & own the outcome;
I'm guided by nature when making decisions;
I treat every customer as precious as water;
I'm always iterating towards excellence;
I make others successful;
I listen with depth and respect.

Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a workplace that champions diversity and inclusivity at every step of our journey.

If you're ready to join a transformative division at a groundbreaking company, then we'd love to get to know you. Apply today and help chart the course to a water-secure world.

**London, England, United Kingdom**

**The Firm**  
XTX Markets is a leading algorithmic trading firm which uses state-of-the-art machine learning technology to produce price forecasts for over 53,000 financial instruments across equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities and crypto. It uses those forecasts to trade on exchanges and alternative trading venues, and to offer differentiated liquidity directly to clients worldwide. The firm trades over $250bn a day across 35 countries and has over 300 employees based in London, Singapore, New York, Paris, Bristol, Mumbai, Yerevan and Kajaani.    
  
We leverage the talent of the people who work here, modern computational techniques and state-of-the-art research infrastructure to analyse large data sets across markets quickly and efficiently, to maximize the effectiveness of our proprietary trading algorithms. We are actively seeking new methods and ideas. The models that drive our trading strategies have evolved considerably over the last 10 years, from econometric methods that gave our company its name, to trees, to neural networks, to modern deep learning architectures.   
  
XTX Markets has an unrivalled level of computational resources in the trading industry, with a growing research cluster currently containing over 25,000 GPUs with more than 1 exabyte of usable storage. Teams across the firm include world-class researchers, developers and technologists with backgrounds in pure math, programming, physics, computer science and machine learning. The firm is also constructing a large-scale data centre in Finland to future-proof its significant computational capabilities.   
  
At XTX Markets technology is our business and we are a diverse organization which attracts outstanding talent from across all industry backgrounds. We are focused on teamwork and our people collaborate on all aspects of the business, working openly and with respect for each other, our clients and the market. Our culture is non-hierarchical and one where everyone is valued. We strive for excellence in everything we do. 

**The Role**The technology and market data procurement department is responsible for achieving value for the firm in the execution of a budget in the hundreds of millions of pounds annually.  
  
This role supports the research, evaluation, sourcing, procurement, and commercial management of technology products and services across the entire firm.  
  
A key aspect of the role is staying up to date with emerging technologies, market trends and vendor capabilities, providing technology guidance and strategic recommendations to engineering, infrastructure and business development teams to support the firm’s technology decisions.  
  
The portfolio includes IT hardware, enterprise software, cloud services, market data, network and connectivity services, datacentre and colocation services, professional services and emerging technologies. You will get broad exposure to a wide range of cutting-edge technology deployments.  
  
You will work closely with engineering, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to understand their requirements, evaluate technical and commercial options, negotiate with suppliers, and support implementation. We are seeking someone who combines sound commercial judgement with the technical aptitude to research unfamiliar technologies, assess vendor proposals and manage initiatives from initial requirements through contract, delivery and lifecycle management.  
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Research, evaluate, negotiate and procure technology products and services across hardware, software, cloud, market data, network and connectivity, datacentre and colocation, professional services and emerging technologies.

* Support the procurement and delivery of complex infrastructure projects, including compute, GPU, storage, network, power, cooling, datacentre capacity and exchange connectivity requirements.
* Manage supplier relationships across OEMs, resellers, software and cloud providers, market data vendors, network carriers, datacentre and colocation providers and professional services firms.
* Support the commercial and procurement workstreams of technology implementation projects, including supplier coordination, delivery planning, risk management, acceptance and operational handover.
* Manage hardware and enterprise software asset lifecycles, including renewals, maintenance, support, utilisation, refresh planning and decommissioning.
* Conduct cost reconciliation, spend analysis, budget tracking, vendor reporting and financial data administration.
* Improve procurement processes, documentation, governance and stakeholder workflows.

* Approximately 3 to 6 years of experience in technology procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor management, solutions architecture, technical project delivery, infrastructure sourcing or a related role.
* Strong technical aptitude and a practical understanding of enterprise technology environments, with the ability to assess requirements, dependencies, implementation considerations and supplier proposals.
* Experience sourcing or delivering complex infrastructure, high-performance compute, GPU, datacentre, colocation, low-latency network or direct-liquid-cooled technology
* Broad knowledge of technology products or services across several categories, such as hardware, software, cloud, data, telecommunications, datacentre services or professional services.

* Commercially astute, with experience running structured sourcing and negotiation processes and evaluating commercial models, contractual terms, supplier risk and total cost of ownership.

* Articulate, analytical and numerate, with strong verbal and written reasoning skills and a bachelor's degree in an analytical, technical, engineering, scientific, financial or quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience working in financial services, trading, research computing or another technically demanding environment would be advantageous.

# Head of Telematics Data Science

**Hybrid**Data and EngineeringFull time

London, England, United Kingdom

## Description

### About Zego

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has.

Good drivers are the entire point of Zego. Seven in 10 drivers on the road are consistently good, but until telematics came along there was no way to prove it, so nearly everyone paid a price based on averages. Zego is the company built to change that.

At Zego, we're leading the AI evolution in insurance.

We move fast, without the layers that usually slow things down. AI takes the routine work off every team, from Finance to Product to Marketing, so people ship real code and launch custom dashboards in minutes. Engineering commits are entirely AI-assisted, which shifts the focus from team size to the quality of your thinking, and our data warehouse connects directly to an AI assistant for instant answers. Backed by a modern tech stack (Claude Code, Snowflake, Figma and Zapier) and a commitment to adopting new tools in days rather than quarters, you get complete ownership to do the most impactful work of your career.

### Purpose of the role

Zego has recorded over a billion miles of real-world driving, captured from phone sensors (accelerometer, GPS and more) across tens of thousands of policies and four very different kinds of driving: private car, van, taxi and delivery. The Telematics team uses digital signal processing and machine learning to turn that raw signal into a precise picture of how people actually drive. We use it to price insurance more fairly, to help drivers be safer on the road, and to power Zego Rewards, everyday rewards for good driving that turn car insurance into an engaging product rather than a box to tick.

We own the full telematics stack (mobile SDK, on-device ML, cloud pipeline) and the full pricing stack. So we can link driving behaviour directly to claim type, frequency and severity, and feed one system's predictions straight into the other. We are one of very few companies that owns that entire loop end to end, on in-house proprietary technology.

As Head of Telematics Data Science you will set the research agenda and own the technical direction of that work, reporting to the Director of Data. You will lead three data scientists directly and three ML engineers with a dotted line to you. The split is roughly 60% leading, 40% hands-on.

Our long-term ambition is driving behaviour modelling that holds up across countries and handsets, is highly predictive of claims risk, and is deeply integrated with driver coaching so we can offer the fairest price and the best experience to good drivers anywhere. Our partnership with Sompo Holdings, one of Japan's largest insurance groups, will take models trained on UK roads into an entirely different market.

**The problems you will be working on**

* Continuously pushing the predictive power of our existing algorithms and ML models
* Telling drivers apart from passengers using sensor data alone
* Detecting crashes and estimating their severity
* Bringing map and road-context data into our models in a way that genuinely improves prediction
* Handling handset and sensor heterogeneity, so a model behaves consistently on a five-year-old Android and a new iPhone
* On-device ML under real battery and compute constraints - trip detection already runs on the phone, and more could
* Making behavioural risk models transfer to new markets, starting with Japan

Several of these are open problems across the industry, not just at Zego.

**What you will be doing**

* Define and drive the technical roadmap, making sure the team is working on the highest-impact problems
* Lead the development of novel models to detect human behaviour and vehicle kinematics from high-frequency phone sensor data, on-device and in the cloud
* Act as the primary technical authority on telematics across the business, advising on existing products, surfacing patterns nobody has thought to look for, and identifying new value propositions
* Build, grow and mentor the team, setting the technical standards needed to produce exceptional work
* Partner with Pricing to integrate telematics predictions into how we price risk, and with Data Products and Engineering to embed telematics insight into Zego's core products
* Push our use of AI in the work itself in analytics, in model development, and in the driver coaching experiences we are building
* Represent our telematics science to senior leadership, commercial teams and partners including Sompo
* Own the metrics that track real-world model impact in production, and make sure our models meet our obligations around fair pricing when a model influences what someone pays, the fairness of that model is part of the job

## Requirements

**What you will need to be successful**

* A Master's or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or a related quantitative field though we are equally happy to talk to people with equivalent industry research experience

* Deep expertise in machine learning and deep learning, preferably with hands-on experience building and deploying models on high-frequency time-series sensor data
* A strong grounding in signal processing: signal modelling, decomposition, transforms and sensor physics
* Experience leading and growing a data science team developing people and delivering through others, without losing touch with the technical work
* Strong software engineering practice: Python, version control, reproducible pipelines and production-ready code
* Experience with large-scale data processing (we use Kafka, Spark and Flink)
* The ability to explain complex technical work clearly to senior leadership, commercial teams and partners, and a bias for connecting research to business outcomes
* Preferably, experience with on-device or embedded ML under compute and power constraints
* Familiarity with regulated environments, or with fairness and bias in applied models, is a plus
* **You work AI-first.** You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

## Benefits

### What it's like to work at Zego

At Zego, we operate like a high-performing sports team. We come together as one, driven by ambition, backed by real support, and united by a shared mission to win.

Working here means having the backing, the coaching, and an inclusive community of Zegons across the UK and Europe who celebrate your wins and raise your game. It also means holding ourselves to high standards: moving with urgency, taking complete ownership, and embracing honest feedback that helps us continuously learn and evolve.

This is your opportunity for a career-defining experience, and one you will own.

.

### The Zego ways of working

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our central London office weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It is about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It is a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year...

### Benefits

* Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year
* Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution
* Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build
* Private medical insurance, for you and your family
* Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new
* Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact

# Senior Enemy (Systems) Designer - Unannouced Project

London, UK

**Level Up Your Career with Zynga!**

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVilleTM, Words With FriendsTM, Zynga PokerTM, Game of Thrones Slots CasinoTM, Wizard of Oz SlotsTM, Hit it Rich! SlotsTM, Wonka SlotsTM, Top ElevenTM, Toon BlastTM, Empires & PuzzlesTM, Merge Dragons!TM, CSR RacingTM, Harry Potter: Puzzles & SpellsTM, Match FactoryTM, and Color Block JamTM—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

#### **Position Overview:**

NaturalMotion is looking for a talented and passionate Enemy Designer to join our London studio, helping shape the combat experience for our first-person shooter mobile title. This role focuses on implementing well known enemies, adapting existing enemies and adding new compelling enemies to bring an authentic console experience to mobile

Sitting at the intersection of design, art, animation, audio, and engineering, you will ensure enemy encounters are polished, purposeful and fun. A core responsibility will be working with Level Design & Combat Design to ensure every enemy encounter is polished, purposeful, and fun. We are looking for someone who brings both craft knowledge and a genuine love of action games.

We embrace a hybrid work environment. Within this role you will work 2 days per week in our London office and the remaining days at home.

#### **What You'll Do:**

* Ownership of designing, prototyping, and implementing enemy behaviours, AI systems, boss encounters & other features that align with the creative vision of the game
* Take enemies and bosses from paper design through to shipping quality, ensuring they are complete, polished and fun for players
* Work with Level Design & Combat Design to ensure enemies, factions, and NPCs meet their goals at every stage of development. Define required metrics to track and achieve them
* Collaborate closely with art, animation, audio, design and engineering teams to build content and solve problems in a multi-disciplinary environment
* Develop and balance a diverse roster of enemies, bosses, mutators & more
* Create compelling AI behaviours & attack patterns that provide an exciting experience and appropriately challenging for players
* Analyse combat data, player feedback, and internal playtests to refine and iterate on enemy and boss designs
* Work concurrently on multiple features at varying stages of development, managing priorities effectively as content pipelines run in parallel
* Document and communicate enemy and boss design concepts clearly to ensure alignment across all development teams

#### **What You Bring:**

* Previous experience in Combat / Enemy Design or an equivalent role in the video game industry
* At least one shipped title in a design role for a Shooter / Action / RPG title
* Experience designing and implementing enemy AI, behaviours, and encounters for action games
* Experience working on a first-person or third-person game
* Familiarity with the Unreal game engine
* Ability to analyse gameplay data and player feedback to inform and balance design decisions
* Strong visual & verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-disciplinary teams
* The ability to manage multiple designs in a fast-paced development environment
* Passionate about action games with a deep understanding of what makes enemy designs engaging and memorable

#### **Bonus Points:**

* Background in live service games and/ or mobile games with an understanding of ongoing balancing and content updates
* Experience with visual scripting or rapid prototyping tools
* An avid gamer with a genuine enthusiasm for crafting memorable and inventive enemy designs

#### **What We Offer You:**

* Competitive salary and discretionary annual bonus scheme
* 26 days holiday, plus bank holidays & 2 paid personal days
* 6 months fully paid maternity/adoption leave and 16 weeks fully paid paternity leave (eligibility criteria applies)
* Pension plan, with a double matching employer contribution
* Private medical & dental insurance and healthcare cash plan
* Life insurance, personal accident insurance and income protection
* Mental health and neurodiversity support programs
* Company Employee Stock Purchase Plan (eligibility criteria applies)
* Fitness reimbursement plan, worth £600 per annum
* Flexible working hours
* Weekly happy hours, seasonal parties and monthly social events
* Annual rail season ticket advance and cycle to work scheme
